title: Home Health Clinical Quality Assurance Nurse (OASIS & Compliance Specialist)
description:
About EZ Scribe LLC: 

EZ Scribe LLC provides clinical documentation and compliance support to U.S.-based home health agencies. Our focus is ensuring accurate, audit-ready documentation that meets Medicare and CMS regulatory standards. 

We are building a high-level Quality Assurance (QA) division to reduce denial risk, improve documentation quality, and ensure full compliance across all client charts. 



Position Overview: 

We are seeking experienced Home Health nurses with strong expertise in OASIS, Medicare compliance, and clinical documentation QA. This is a specialized QA role, not a general nursing position. Candidates must be able to independently review patient charts and identify clinical, regulatory, and reimbursement risks before submission. 



Core Responsibilities: 

-Perform end-to-end QA audits of home health patient charts 

-Validate compliance with: Medicare guidelines, CMS Conditions of Participation (CoPs) 

-Conduct detailed OASIS-E review, including: Accuracy of responses, Functional scoring (ADLs/IADLs), Consistency with clinical documentation 

-Audit Plan of Care (485) for:  Clinical accuracy and completeness, Alignment with diagnoses, interventions, and visit frequency 

-Validate documentation supporting: Homebound status, Medical necessity, Skilled need for services 

-Review: Physician orders (accuracy, completeness, timeliness), Face-to-face encounter documentation 

-Cross-check consistency between: OASIS , Visit notes , Plan of Care 

-Identify and flag: Documentation gaps, Contradictions or cloned notes, Missing or unsupported skilled services 

-Evaluate PDGM-related factors impacting reimbursement 

-Ensure charts are audit-ready for: ADR (Additional Documentation Requests), RAC / UPIC audits, State surveys 

-Provide clear, actionable QA feedback to clinicians and internal teams 



Licensing and Experience Requirements:

-Be a Registered Nurse (RN) licensed by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) – Philippines 

-License may be active or previously active, however: Active PRC license is strongly preferred, Candidates with expired licenses must demonstrate recent clinical or documentation-related experience 

-Must be able to provide: PRC license number , Proof of licensure (PRC ID or equivalent documentation) 

-Minimum 5+ years of clinical nursing experience, preferably in ICU, critical care, or other advanced clinical settings, with exposure to home health QA or U.S.-based healthcare documentation processes 

OR 

-Minimum 3+ year of experience in Home Health QA, OASIS review, or U.S. healthcare documentation support 

Demonstrated experience or strong familiarity with Medicare CMS documentation standards for U.S. home health agencies 



Note: A U.S. nursing license (NCLEX-RN) is not required for this role but will be considered a strong advantage. 



Required Core Skill Set: 

1. OASIS Proficiency (Mandatory) 

Strong working knowledge of OASIS-E 

Understanding of item intent and scoring logic 

Ability to identify: Inaccurate responses, Inconsistencies with clinical notes 

Understanding of impact on: Quality measures, Reimbursement (PDGM) 



2. Medicare & CMS Regulatory Knowledge 

Home health eligibility requirements 

Homebound status criteria 

Skilled need qualification standards 

CMS Conditions of Participation (CoPs) 

Documentation requirements for claim approval 



3. Plan of Care (485) & Orders Review 

Certification and recertification requirements 

Diagnosis appropriateness and sequencing awareness 

Visit frequency validation 

Alignment between physician orders and clinical documentation 



4. Medical Necessity & Skilled Services Validation 

Ability to determine whether documentation supports: Skilled nursing or therapy services, Continued need for care 

Identification of denial risk due to insufficient documentation 



5. PDGM & Reimbursement Awareness 

Understanding of: Clinical groupings , Functional impairment levels, Comorbidity adjustments 

Ability to identify documentation issues that may impact reimbursement 



6. Documentation Consistency & Chart Integrity 

Cross-referencing: OASIS vs visit notes vs Plan of Care 

Identifying: Contradictions , Missing documentation , Incomplete care narratives 



7. ICD-10 Coding Awareness (QA-Level) 

Ability to: Identify unsupported or invalid diagnoses, Recognize improper primary diagnosis selection , Ensure documentation supports coded conditions 



8. Audit & Survey Readiness 

Familiarity with: ADR (Additional Documentation Requests), RAC (Recovery Audit Contractor) reviews, UPIC audits 

State survey expectations 

Ability to proactively identify high-risk charts 



9. EMR Proficiency 

Experience navigating multiple EMR systems 

Ability to adapt quickly to different agency workflows 



Preferred Certifications (Strongly Valued): 

-OASIS Certification (COS-C or equivalent) 

-Home health coding certification (e.g., HCS-D) 

-Healthcare compliance certification 

-HIPAA certification (U.S.-aligned) 



Familiarity with the following EMR (preferred): 

-Synergy  

-Homecare Homebase 

-WellSky / Kinnser 

-Axxess 

-Devero 

-Data Soft Logic 

-Epic 



-Experience supporting U.S.-based agencies remotely 



Key Competencies: 

-High attention to detail and accuracy 

-Strong critical thinking and clinical judgment 

-Ability to work independently with minimal supervision 

-Clear, structured written communication 

-Consistent application of regulatory standards 



Data Security & Compliance Requirements: 

-Strict adherence to HIPAA regulations 

-No local storage of patient data (PHI) 

-Must maintain a secure, private workspace 

-Use of company-approved systems and workflows only 



Performance Expectations:

-Meet defined QA turnaround times  (typically less than 48 hours)

-Maintain high accuracy with minimal rework 

-Consistently identify compliance risks before submission 



Application Requirements 

Submit: 

-Updated resume/CV 

-Summary of home health and OASIS experience 

-Description of QA, audit, or compliance work 

-List of EMR systems used 

-Certifications (if applicable) 

-Availability and preferred schedule 



Important Note:

This role directly impacts Medicare reimbursement, audit outcomes, and regulatory compliance for U.S. healthcare agencies. 

Only candidates with demonstrated home health documentation expertise and OASIS competency should apply. 

 

EZ Scribe LLC is building a high-precision QA team. This role requires accuracy, accountability, and advanced regulatory knowledge.

mbers to resolve coding questions and documentation deficiencies.

-Clinical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Medicare Conditions of Participation, PDGM, OASIS guidelines and plan of care requirements. Ability to recognize documentation errors and ensure data integrity.

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller — Web Design Agency (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
THE COMPANY

We are a web design agency that builds high-quality professional websites for established businesses across the United States. Our clients are business owners in industries like roofing, HVAC, construction, med spas, chiropractic, and other high-ticket service businesses. These are not startups — they are existing businesses that are already making money and ready to invest in their online presence.

We are growing fast and looking for a driven, organized, and persistent appointment setter to join our team remotely.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Your primary job is to find potential clients and get them on a call with our sales team. You own the entire top of the funnel — from finding the lead to booking the appointment.

Lead Generation:



Research US-based businesses in target industries using Google, Yelp, Google Maps, and similar tools

Build your own lead list daily — roofing companies, HVAC companies, contractors, med spas, chiropractors, electricians, plumbers, and similar established service businesses

Identify businesses that already have revenue but have a weak or outdated online presence

Track all leads in a shared Google Sheet — business name, owner name, phone, website, industry, call status, notes



Cold Calling:



Make outbound calls to business owners during US business hours

Follow a proven script — we will provide it

Qualify leads — are they an established business with revenue? Do they have a weak website or no website? Are they open to improving their online presence?

Handle objections confidently and professionally

Book qualified appointments on our sales rep's calendar using a scheduling tool



Follow-Up:



Follow up with leads who did not answer on the first attempt — minimum 3 attempts per lead before marking as no contact

Send follow-up texts or
s to warm leads after initial contact

Re-engage old leads who were interested but did not book

Keep your lead tracker updated in real time — every call logged, every outcome noted



Additional Responsibilities:



Research competitor websites for industries you are calling so you can speak intelligently about what a better website would do for them

Flag any leads who seem especially hot to the sales team immediately

Suggest new industries or niches to target based on what you are seeing in the market

Help build and refine the script over time based on what objections come up most





WHO THIS IS FOR

This person is the right fit if they:



Have done cold calling or outbound sales before and are not afraid of rejection

Are extremely organized — you live in your spreadsheet and your calendar

Communicate clearly and professionally in English — written and spoken

Are self-motivated — you do not need someone to tell you to make calls

Are comfortable finding their own leads from scratch every day

Have reliable internet and a quiet place to work

Are available during US business hours — at minimum 9am to 5pm in at least one US time zone





WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

Do not apply if:



You have never made cold calls before and are not willing to learn fast

You need someone to hand you a list every day

You are looking for a passive or low-effort role

You give up after one or two rejections

Your English is not strong enough to have a confident business conversation





COMPENSATION



Base pay: $3–$5 per hour depending on experience

Performance bonus: $10 per qualified appointment that shows up to the call. High performers can receive more than this. 

Commission opportunity: For top performers who can eventually close deals independently, commission of up to $200 per closed website deal

This role has room to grow — the right person can move from setter to closer





WHAT A GREAT DAY LOOKS LIKE



100+ calls made daily

5–10 qualified appointments booked daily

Every call logged with outcome and notes

Follow-ups sent to all warm leads from the week prior

Lead tracker fully up to date by end of Friday



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered you must do the following exactly — applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



Start your application with the subject line or first line: "MALIBU READY"

Write 3–5 sentences about your cold calling experience — be specific, not general

Tell us what industry you would target first and why

Tell us what you would say in the first 10 seconds of a cold call to a roofing company owner

Include your resume or work history



Applications that do not start with "MALIBU READY" will be automatically filtered out. This is intentional. It tells us you read carefully and follow instructions — two things this job requires every single day.



ADDITIONAL TASKS THIS SAME PERSON CAN OWN

Here's everything else you can stack onto this role that a good appointment setter can handle without it becoming a different job:



CRM data entry — logging all calls, outcomes, and follow-ups into a shared sheet or CRM tool

Prospect research — building lead lists for new industries or cities before calling begins

 outreach — sending cold
s to businesses that didn't answer the phone, following a template

Social media lead gen — finding business owners through
 groups, Instagram, or LinkedIn who might be a fit

Script testing — trying different openers and reporting back what gets the best response rate

Appointment confirmation — texting or
ing booked leads 24 hours before their appointment to reduce no-shows

No-show re-engagement — calling back people who missed their appointment to reschedule

Competitor research — identifying businesses in each niche with bad websites and flagging them as priority targets

Weekly reporting — sending a simple end-of-week report: calls made, appointments booked, no contacts, follow-ups pending

description:
About the Company

Patrick Capital Group LLC is the company behind The Outcast Investor — a fast-growing real estate and financial education brand helping first-generation wealth builders break the cycle of generational poverty. We move fast, we post daily, and we hold a high bar: every piece of content must feel premium and stay true to the brand. We are looking for a skilled content creator and editor to turn our raw footage and ideas into finished, scroll-stopping content.



The Role

You are the hands that turn raw material into polished, postable content. We will give you access to our Content Vault — a library of raw video clips, photos, property footage, and ideas. Your job is to edit that raw material into finished short-form videos (reels/TikToks) and branded graphics/carousels, following the direction of our Social Media Manager. You are the craftsperson; the Social Media Manager sets the direction and priorities.



Primary Responsibilities

?  Edit raw footage into finished short-form videos: cuts, pacing, captions/subtitles, music, hooks, and on-screen text.

?  Design branded graphics and multi-slide carousels (quote graphics, value posts, before/after style proof posts).

?  Apply our brand identity consistently: colors (Obsidian Black, Legacy Gold, Burgundy Red), fonts, logo placement, and premium feel.

?  Organize and manage the Content Vault — keep raw and finished assets labeled and easy to find.

?  Deliver assets on schedule so the Social Media Manager can post 3x per day without delays.

?  Take direction and revisions from the Social Media Manager and turn them around quickly.



What You Must Know

?  Strong short-form video editing skills (CapCut, Captions, Premiere, or similar) — please send samples or a portfolio.

?  Graphic design for social media (Canva or Adobe) — clean, modern, on-brand work.

?  An eye for hooks, pacing, and retention — you understand what makes someone stop scrolling.

?  Ability to follow a brand guide exactly and stay consistent across every asset.

?  Reliable, responsive, and able to hit small deadlines working remotely.

?  Bonus: experience editing talking-head / personal-story content and faceless value content.



How You'll Stay On-Brand

You will not need to manage strategy or tools on your own. Our Social Media Manager directs your work — they provide the brief, the priorities, the brand guidelines, and any AI-generated outlines or scripts you need. You focus purely on execution and craft. We will share our brand guide and examples so your work matches our look from day one.



Access & Materials

You will receive access to our Content Vault (raw clips, photos, and ideas) so you can do the work. You will NOT receive access to company accounts, logins, billing, or our CRM. All direction and brand materials come to you through the Social Media Manager. This keeps the working relationship clean and protects both of us.



Compensation

?  Starting rate: $4/hour USD.

?  Paid 2-hour trial task to start — you edit one short video and create one graphic so we can see your work before any ongoing commitment.

?  Performance bonuses available as part of a longer-term partnership for the right person.

?  Room to grow: strong performers will be considered for an expanded, ongoing role with more hours and responsibility.



Hiring Process

To help us understand your working style and strengths, qualified applicants will complete a few simple standardized assessments (skills + personality). These are quick and help us place the right person in the right seat — there are no trick questions.

?  Step 1: Apply with a short note + your portfolio (video edits AND graphic samples).

?  Step 2: Complete the simple standardized assessments.

?  Step 3: Paid 2-hour trial task (one video edit + one graphic).

?  Step 4: Decision on an ongoing role.



How to Apply

Reply with: (1) a brief intro, (2) your portfolio or 2–3 samples of short-form video edits AND graphics you've made, (3) your availability per week, and (4) which editing and design tools you use. Applications with real, relevant samples move to the front of the line.

title: E-commerce Finance & Accounting Specialist
description:
We are looking for a reliable and proactive finance employee to manage the day-to-day financial operations of our e-commerce businesses.



The role includes tracking invoices and payments, managing our accounts-payable Gmail inbox, maintaining QuickBooks, reconciling Wise, PayPal, banks and payment processors, tracking inventory, preparing financial reports, and potentially helping with cash-flow forecasting.



This is not a role for someone who only follows SOPs. We need someone who takes ownership, notices problems, investigates discrepancies, and reports unexpected issues promptly.



## Responsibilities



•?  ?Manage the accounts-payable Gmail inbox

•?  ?Track vendor and contractor invoices

•?  ?Organize invoices using Gmail labels

•?  ?Record invoice amounts, currencies, due dates and payment status

•?  ?Check for duplicate, incorrect or suspicious invoices

•?  ?Prepare payments through Wise, PayPal and bank accounts

•?  ?Track scheduled, completed, failed and overdue payments

•?  ?Maintain accurate records in QuickBooks

•?  ?Reconcile banks, credit cards, Wise, PayPal, Shopify and payment processors

•?  ?Track Shopify sales, refunds, chargebacks, fees and payouts

•?  ?Track payment-processor reserves, holds and delayed payouts

•?  ?Track inventory levels and stock movements

•?  ?Reconcile inventory records with Shopify, suppliers and warehouses

•?  ?Track purchase orders, supplier deposits and incoming inventory

•?  ?Maintain inventory valuation, COGS and landed-cost records

•?  ?Track advertising, shipping, fulfilment, software and processing expenses

•?  ?Prepare weekly and monthly financial reports

•?  ?Report unpaid invoices, upcoming payments and cash requirements

•?  ?Assist with cash-flow forecasting, budgeting and financial planning

•?  ?Keep financial documents organized for accountants and tax filings



## Reporting



You must promptly report unexpected issues such as:



•?  ?Missing or duplicate invoices

•?  ?Unusual charges

•?  ?Changes to vendor payment details

•?  ?Failed or delayed payments

•?  ?Missing payouts

•?  ?Reconciliation discrepancies

•?  ?Processor reserves or account holds

•?  ?Inventory shortages

•?  ?Unexpected increases in costs

•?  ?Suspicious transactions



Your report should explain what happened, the financial impact, what you investigated, and your recommended next step.



## Requirements



•?  ?Previous finance, bookkeeping or accounting experience

•?  ?E-commerce or DTC experience

•?  ?Strong QuickBooks knowledge

•?  ?Experience with Wise, PayPal, Shopify and online banking

•?  ?Strong spreadsheet skills

•?  ?Understanding of inventory, COGS and reconciliations

•?  ?Strong attention to detail

•?  ?High initiative and independent problem-solving ability

•?  ?Clear written English

•?  ?Reliable communication and follow-through

•?  ?Ability to handle sensitive financial information responsibly



## Security



You may prepare payments, but final payment approval will remain with management.



Any changes to vendor banking information must be independently verified before payment.



## To Apply



Please include:



1.? ?A summary of your e-commerce finance or bookkeeping experience

2.? ?The software and payment platforms you have used

3.? ?Your experience with QuickBooks, inventory and reconciliations

4.? ?An example of a financial discrepancy you identified and resolved

About Growing Pains Marketing



Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency focused on helping DTC eCommerce brands scale through paid social advertising, primarily on Meta.



We work with fast-moving brands in competitive and compliance-sensitive categories, including wellness, CBD-adjacent, research compounds, alternative products, and other restricted markets.



Our team uses AI every day to improve creative production, research, reporting, operations, automation, and media buying workflows.



We are looking for an AI Developer who has experience working with or inside a digital marketing agency and understands how agencies operate: client accounts, ad creative, media buying, reporting, SOPs, team workflows, dashboards, and automations.



This is not just a general coding role. We need someone who can build practical AI-powered systems that make the agency faster, smarter, and more efficient.



Role Overview



We are hiring an AI Developer to help build internal AI tools, automations, workflows, agents, dashboards, and integrations for our agency.



You will work with leadership, media buyers, creative strategists, project managers, designers, video editors, and operators to identify repetitive workflows and turn them into useful AI-assisted systems.



Your job is to help us use AI to reduce manual work, improve speed, organize information, support decision-making, and create internal tools that actually get used by the team.



This role requires both technical skill and practical agency understanding.



Must-Have Requirements



You must have:



Previous experience working with or inside a digital marketing agency.

Strong daily experience building with AI tools, LLMs, agents, or automations.

Experience with APIs, webhooks, databases, and workflow automation.

Ability to build useful internal tools, not just experiments.

Strong understanding of marketing workflows, creative production, reporting, or paid ads operations.

Ability to take messy business problems and turn them into working systems.

Strong written and spoken English.

Ability to communicate clearly with non-technical tea
mbers.

Ability to work Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–3:00 PM EST.

Ability to submit a Loom video that is 5 minutes or less.



Please do not apply if you only build generic AI demos and have no understanding of agency workflows. We need someone who understands marketing operations and can build tools that solve real agency problems.



AI Requirement



AI is the core of this role.



You should be comfortable working with tools and concepts such as:



ChatGPT / OpenAI API.

Claude / Anthropic.

Gemini.

Perplexity.

Cursor.

Replit.

Make.

Zapier.

n8n.

Airtable.

Google Sheets.

Google Apps Script.

APIs and webhooks.

Vector databases or knowledge bases.

RAG workflows.

AI agents.

Prompt engineering.

Workflow automation.

Internal dashboards.

CRM and marketing platform integrations.



You do not need to know every tool listed, but you must be able to learn quickly and build practical systems using AI.



What You’ll Own



You will help build and maintain AI-powered systems across the agency.



This may include:



Internal AI agents.

Creative research tools.

Ad analysis tools.

Reporting automation.

Slack-to-Asana workflows.

SOP/documentation assistants.

Client dashboard automations.

Creative brief generators.

Ad performance summary tools.

Google Sheets automations.

API integrations.

Workflow automations between Slack, Asana, Google Drive, Notion, Airtable, GoHighLevel, Triple Whale, Shopify, Meta, or other tools.

AI systems that help the team move faster and reduce repetitive work.

Core Responsibilities

1. AI Workflow Development



You will build AI-assisted workflows that help the team work faster.



Responsibilities include:



Identify repetitive agency tasks that can be automated or assisted with AI.

Build tools that summarize, organize, and structure information.

Create AI workflows for creative, media buying, reporting, and operations.

Turn messy inputs into clear outputs.

Improve internal processes with automation.

Build lightweight tools that tea
mbers can actually use.

Test workflows and improve them based on team feedback.

2. Automation and Integrations



You will connect tools and systems to reduce manual work.



Responsibilities include:



Build automations using tools like Make, Zapier, n8n, Google Apps Script, or custom code.

Connect tools through APIs and webhooks.

Automate data movement between platforms.

Create workflows between Slack, Asana, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Notion, Airtable, CRM tools, reporting platforms, and ad platforms where possible.

Troubleshoot broken automations.

Document how automations work.

Make systems reliable, not fragile.

3. Internal Tools and Agents



You will help create internal tools and agents for the team.



Examples include:



AI assistant for creating creative briefs.

AI assistant for summarizing Slack threads into Asana tasks.

AI assistant for checking if creative tasks are missing required information.

AI reporting assistant that summarizes account performance.

AI research assistant for competitor and market research.

AI SOP assistant that answers questions from internal documentation.

AI QA assistant for checking ad copy, creative briefs, or task completeness.

AI dashboard for leadership updates.



The goal is to create tools that reduce manual thinking and repetitive admin work without removing human judgment.



4. Data, Reporting, and Dashboard Support



You may help build tools that support reporting and performance analysis.



Responsibilities may include:



Pulling data from ad platforms or reporting tools.

Organizing data in Google Sheets, Airtable, or dashboards.

Creating AI summaries of performance trends.

Helping media buyers review account changes.

Building simple dashboards for leadership or client updates.

Automating daily or weekly performance summaries.

Creating alerts for unusual changes or blockers.



You do not need to be a media buyer, but you should understand marketing metrics enough to build useful reporting tools.



5. Technical Problem Solving



You will be expected to solve problems independently.



Responsibilities include:



Translate business requests into technical requirements.

Ask clarifying questions when needed.

Recommend simple solutions instead of overcomplicated systems.

Build quickly, test, and improve.

Debug issues.

Keep systems organized.

Document what you build.

Explain technical concepts in simple language.

6. Documentation and Handoff



Every system you build should be documented clearly enough for the team to understand.



Documentation should include:



What the tool does.

Who uses it.

How to use it.

What inputs are required.

What outputs it creates.

What tools/APIs it connects to.

What can break.

How to troubleshoot basic issues.

Where credentials or settings are managed, without exposing sensitive information.

Example Projects You Might Build

A Slack workflow that turns messy creative feedback into clean Asana tasks.

An AI assistant that reviews creative briefs for missing information.

A Google Sheets automation that summarizes daily ad performance.

A reporting assistant that creates plain-English account summaries.

A competitor research tool that organizes findings into angles, hooks, and offers.

A knowledge base assistant trained on internal SOPs.

An AI tool that helps creative strategists generate first-draft research summaries.

A dashboard that shows creative production status across clients.

A system that checks whether tasks have owners, due dates, assets, and deadlines.

A workflow that helps organize creator submissions and revision notes.

What This Role Is Not



This role is not primarily:



A generic prompt engineering role.

A pure software engineering role with no marketing context.

A media buying role.

A creative strategist role.

A designer role.

A VA role.

A role for building flashy demos that do not solve real problems.



We need someone who can build useful AI systems for a real agency team.

Digital marketing agency experience.

Strong AI tool usage.

Experience building automations.

Experience working with APIs and webhooks.

Experience with Google Sheets or Airtable.

Experience with Make, Zapier, n8n, or similar tools.

Ability to work independently.

Preferred Skills

Experience with RAG or knowledge base systems.

Experience building AI agents.

Experience with Python, JavaScript, or Google Apps Script.

Experience with Cursor, Replit, or similar coding tools.

Experience with Slack, Asana, Google Drive, Notion, Airtable, or Google Sheets automations.

Experience with Meta Ads, Shopify, Triple Whale, GoHighLevel, or other marketing platforms.

Experience building dashboards.

Experience with DTC eCommerce marketing.

Experience working in a remote agency team.

Tools You May Use



You should be comfortable using or learning:



ChatGPT / OpenAI.

Claude / Anthropic.

Gemini.

Perplexity.

Cursor.

Replit.

Make.

Zapier.

n8n.

Google Apps Script.

Google Sheets.

Airtable.

Notion.

Slack.

Asana.

Google Drive.

APIs and webhooks.

Databases or vector databases.

Dashboard tools.

Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is:



AI-native.

Practical, not theoretical.

Experienced with digital marketing agency workflows.

Strong at automation.

Good at building fast MVPs.

Able to improve systems based on feedback.

Comfortable with messy business problems.

Strong in written and spoken English.

Able to explain technical things simply.

Organized with documentation.

Good at debugging.

Curious and resourceful.

Able to work independently.

Focused on business outcomes, not just technical complexity.

Success Looks Like



You are successful in this role if:



The team uses the tools you build.

Manual work is reduced.

Reporting and summaries become faster.

Creative and operations workflows become cleaner.

AI systems save leadership and tea
mbers time.

Automations are reliable.

Systems are documented.

Tools solve real problems.

You can take an unclear request and turn it into a working solution.

The agency becomes faster because of what you build.

Key Performance Indicators



We will evaluate performance based on:



Number of useful AI workflows built.

Reliability of automations.

Reduction in manual work.

Team adoption of tools.

Speed of execution.

Quality of documentation.

Ability to troubleshoot issues.

Accuracy of AI outputs.

Ability to understand agency needs.

Communication quality.

Leadership confidence in your systems.

Work Schedule



This is a remote role.



Required working hours are:



Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–3:00 PM EST



You must be available during these hours for communication, updates, project coordination, troubleshooting, and team collaboration.



Because our agency moves quickly, you should be able to provide timely updates, respond to important messages, and keep projects moving without needing constant reminders.



Compensation

title: FUNNEL TECHNICIAN & SOCIAL MEDIA ASSISTANT
description:
About the Company



Patrick Capital Group LLC is the company behind The Outcast Investor — a fast-growing real estate and financial education brand helping first-generation wealth builders break the cycle of generational poverty. We are early-stage, building in public, and moving fast. We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented contractor to take technical and content tasks off the founder's plate so he can focus on strategy and growth.



The Role

This is a hands-on support role. Your primary job is to keep our sales funnel running smoothly and assist with social media content. The funnel currently takes too much of the founder's time to troubleshoot — your job is to own that problem so it stops being a bottleneck. Over time, strong performers can grow into a larger, ongoing role.



Primary Responsibilities

?  Build, edit, and troubleshoot sales funnels inside GoHighLevel (our CRM/funnel platform).

?  Diagnose and fix funnel issues quickly — broken steps, form errors, automation that isn't firing, page display problems.

?  Connect and test funnel pages, domains, opt-in forms, and
/SMS automations.

?  Assist with social media: scheduling posts, light video/graphic editing, organizing content, and basic captions support.

?  Keep a simple log of what was changed and what was fixed, so we always know the current status.



What You Must Know

?  Hands-on experience building or managing funnels in GoHighLevel (required — please name specific funnels you've built).

?  Comfortable troubleshooting technical issues independently without hand-holding.

?  Clear written English and responsive communication.

?  Reliable internet, able to work remotely, and able to meet small deadlines.

?  Bonus: experience with social media scheduling tools and basic video editing (CapCut, Captions, Canva).



Access & Security

You will be given EDITING access to our CRM only — scoped to the funnel work. You will NOT receive owner/admin access, billing access, or our master login. This protects both of us and keeps the working relationship clean and professional.



Compensation

?  Starting rate: $4/hour USD.

?  Paid 2-hour trial task to start — you complete a short real task so we can see your work before any ongoing commitment.

?  Performance bonuses available as part of a longer-term partnership for the right person.

?  Room to grow: strong performers will be considered for an expanded, ongoing role with more hours and responsibility.



Hiring Process

To help us understand your working style and strengths, qualified applicants will complete a few simple standardized assessments (skills + personality). These are quick and help us place the right person in the right seat — there are no trick questions.



?  Step 1: Apply with a short note + examples of funnels you've built in GoHighLevel.

?  Step 2: Complete the simple standardized assessments.

?  Step 3: Paid 2-hour trial task.

?  Step 4: Decision on an ongoing role.



How to Apply

Reply with: (1) a brief intro, (2) the GoHighLevel funnels you've personally built or fixed, (3) your availability per week, and (4) one sentence on why this work interests you. Applications that show real GoHighLevel experience move to the front of the line.

title: Cloud Migration Engineer (GCP ? Azure)
description:
Company Overview

We are a digital health platform delivering AI-driven music therapy solutions to nursing home facilities across the United States. Their current infrastructure runs on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), utilizing NestJS/TypeScript microservices, Python FastAPI ML services, MySQL 8, Redis Cluster, Pub/Sub, Flutter mobile applications, and an Angular dashboard.

This is a hands-on technical role for someone with proven real-world production migration experience using both gcloud and az CLI environments. The selected candidate will work closely with the engineering team to architect, execute, and complete the migration while ensuring system stability, scalability, and minimal downtime.



Key Responsibilities

• Lead the end-to-end migration of Rubato’s infrastructure from GCP to Azure.

• Map existing GCP services to Azure equivalents and recommend the best architecture solutions.

• Execute phased migration plans with minimal or zero downtime.

• Handle cross-cloud migration of MySQL databases and Redis state management.

• Configure and manage Azure infrastructure components including networking, security, storage, and identity access management.

• Conduct knowledge transfer sessions and provide post-migration support documentation.

• Collaborate closely with engineering and DevOps teams throughout the migration process.



Current GCP Stack

• Cloud Run

• Pub/Sub

• Cloud SQL MySQL

• Memorystore Redis

• Secret Manager

• Cloud Storage

• IAM



Target Azure Stack

• Azure Container Apps or AKS

• Azure Service Bus

• Azure Database for MySQL

• Azure Cache for Redis

• Azure Key Vault

• Azure Blob Storage

• Entra ID / RBAC



Must-Have Requirements

• Strong hands-on experience with:

o Azure Container Apps or AKS

o Azure Service Bus

o Azure Database for MySQL

o Azure Cache for Redis

o Azure Key Vault

• Strong MySQL operational knowledge including replication, backup/restore, and cross-cloud migration.

Nice-to-Have

• Experience supporting healthcare or HIPAA-adjacent platforms.

• Experience with Terraform or Infrastructure-as-Code tooling.

title: DTC eCommerce Creative Strategist - Up to 5k USD/mo
description:
Remote | Full-Time | Meta Ads Focus | 



About Growing Pains Marketing



Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency focused on scaling DTC eCommerce brands through paid social, creative strategy, and direct response advertising.



We specialize in Meta ads and work with brands in competitive and often restricted categories, including wellness, supplements, CBD-adjacent products, telemedicine, research compounds, and other markets where strong creative strategy, compliance awareness, and fast execution matter.



We are looking for a DTC eCommerce Creative Strategist who understands Meta ads inside and out, can turn research into strong creative briefs, and can help launch, monitor, and improve ad creative across multiple client accounts.



This is not just a “make pretty ads” role.



We need someone who can think strategically, understand customer psychology, study competitors, identify winning angles, write strong briefs, collaborate with designers/editors/UGC creators, and help us consistently produce ads that drive purchases.



Role Overview



As our Creative Strategist, you will be responsible for researching markets, developing creative angles, writing briefs, coordinating creative production, uploading/launching ads in Meta, and monitoring performance to identify what is working.



You should be comfortable working across multiple DTC eCommerce accounts and moving quickly without sacrificing strategy or quality.



You will work closely with media buyers, designers, video editors, UGC creators, and leadership to ensure each account has a strong pipeline of new creative.



Key Responsibilities

Creative Strategy



Develop creative strategies for DTC eCommerce brands running Meta ads.



Research customer avatars, pain points, desires, objections, competitor positioning, reviews, Reddit threads, TikTok trends, Meta Ad Library, Amazon reviews, landing pages, and customer language.



Identify new hooks, angles, offers, formats, and messaging opportunities.



Create clear creative testing plans based on performance data and market research.



Understand direct response principles, buyer psychology, and how to structure ads that convert.



Creative Briefs



Write detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators.



Include hooks, concepts, scripts, visual direction, claims/compliance notes, CTA, product positioning, and references.



Make sure briefs are specific enough that the creative team can execute without confusion.



Provide examples of winning ads, swipe files, and references when needed.



Meta Ads Execution



Upload, launch, and organize ads inside Meta Ads Manager.



Understand Meta campaign structure, ad sets, ad naming conventions, creative testing, and basic performance monitoring.



Know how to read creative performance inside Meta and identify winners, losers, and patterns.



Work with media buyers to understand what creative needs to be tested next.



Monitor active ads and help determine when creative needs to be paused, iterated, or scaled.



Creative Performance Analysis



Review ad performance by hook, angle, format, offer, product, audience, and creative type.



Identify why certain ads are working or not working.



Use performance data to inform future creative briefs.



Track winning patterns across accounts.



Help build a repeatable creative testing system.



Client-Facing Communication



Communicate clearly and professionally with clients when needed.



Present creative strategies, explain why certain angles are being tested, and provide updates on creative direction.



Strong written and spoken English is required.



You must be able to explain your thinking clearly on calls, in Slack, and in Loom videos.



Requirements



You must have experience with DTC eCommerce creative strategy.



You must understand Meta ads deeply, especially for purchase/conversion campaigns.



You must be able to upload, launch, and monitor ads inside Meta Ads Manager.



You must know how to create creative briefs that designers, editors, and UGC creators can actually execute.



You must understand customer research, competitor research, and offer positioning.



You must have excellent written and spoken English.



You must be comfortable recording Loom videos explaining your strategy.



You must be organized, fast, and able to manage multiple accounts.



You must be comfortable working with restricted or compliance-sensitive categories.



You must be available during some U.S. working hours.



We are not hiring candidates located in North America for this role.



Nice to Have



Experience with CBD, supplements, peptides, telemedicine, health/wellness, or other restricted categories.



Experience sourcing or managing UGC creators.



Experience writing UGC scripts.



Experience with tools like Triple Whale, Motion, Foreplay, Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Shopify, or GoHighLevel.



Experience working inside an agency.



Compensation



Base pay: $1,500–$3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and skill level.



Bonus: $100/month per account that maintains KPI on a monthly basis.



Expected account load: 10–20 accounts per month.



If you are able to handle more accounts while maintaining quality, that is a plus.



Hiring Process

Step 1: Application



You will complete the application questions below and submit examples of your previous work.



Step 2: Level 1 Test



If your application looks strong, we will send you a Level 1 creative strategy test.



Step 3: Interview



If your Level 1 test is strong, we will schedule an interview.



Step 4: Level 2 Test



Final candidates will complete a paid, more advanced creative strategy test before an offer is made.



Application Requirements



Please answer the questions below carefully. Generic answers will not be considered.



You must also include a Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your experience and walking us through how you think about creative strategy.



Application Questions



Experience

How many years of experience do you have with DTC eCommerce creative strategy?

What types of products or industries have you created ad strategies for?

Have you worked with Meta ads specifically? Explain your experience with campaign setup, ad launching, and performance monitoring.



Creative Strategy

Walk us through your process for going from product research to creative angles.

What makes a strong Meta ad creative for a DTC eCommerce brand?

Share 2–3 examples of creative briefs you have personally created. Include links or screenshots if possible.



Research Process

What sources do you use when researching customers, competitors, and ad angles?

How do you find customer pain points, objections, and buying triggers?

Give an example of a time your research led to a winning ad angle.



Performance Analysis

What metrics do you look at when judging whether an ad creative is working?

How do you d
 whether to kill, iterate, or scale a creative?

Give an example of an ad that failed and what you learned from it.



Communication

This is a client-facing role. How comfortable are you explaining creative strategy to clients?

Please include a Loom video under 5 minutes introducing yourself and explaining your creative strategy process.

Rate your spoken and written English from 1–10 and briefly explain.



Availability & Fit

What country and time zone are you located in?

Are you available to work some U.S. business hours?

What monthly compensation are you looking for in USD?



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your resume or portfolio.



Examples of creative briefs you have created.



Examples of ads you helped strategize.



A Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your creative strategy process.



Answers to the application questions above.

This role works Vancouver time (Pacific Standard / Pacific Daylight Time) — Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. This is a hard requirement. Our clients and our market operate on this schedule, and you will be expected to be present and responsive during these hours.

Who Thrives on This Team

You are organized to the point that other people notice. You communicate before you're asked. You read a document all the way through before responding. You notice when something doesn't add up. You are proud of the quality of your work and you take ownership of your file like it's yours.



You want to build something — not just fill a role. You are looking for a team that will invest in you and give you room to grow. You are not looking for a side gig. You are looking for a career.





How to Apply — Read This Carefully

A screenshot of your internet speed test (from fast.com or speedtest.net)





Compensation & What We Offer

Base Rate:

$9.00 – $11.00 CDN per hour, full-time (40 hours/week), based on experience and demonstrated Canadian real estate knowledge.

13th month bonus (paid annually — this is a standard we honour without exception)

We are not looking for the cheapest option. We are looking for the right person. If you bring the skills, the professionalism, and the commitment — we will take care of you and grow together.

title: UP TO $5,000+ USD/MO DTC - ECOM CREATIVE STRATEGIST
description:
Hiring  DTC - ECOM CREATIVE STRATEGIST 

Remote | Full-Time | Meta Ads Focus | Restricted Categories



About Growing Pains Marketing



Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency focused on scaling DTC eCommerce brands through paid social, creative strategy, and direct response advertising.



We specialize in Meta ads and work with brands in competitive and often restricted categories, including wellness, supplements, CBD-adjacent products, telemedicine, research compounds, and other markets where strong creative strategy, compliance awareness, and fast execution matter.



We are looking for a DTC eCommerce Creative Strategist who understands Meta ads inside and out, can turn research into strong creative briefs, and can help launch, monitor, and improve ad creative across multiple client accounts.



This is not just a “make pretty ads” role.



We need someone who can think strategically, understand customer psychology, study competitors, identify winning angles, write strong briefs, collaborate with designers/editors/UGC creators, and help us consistently produce ads that drive purchases.



Role Overview



As our Creative Strategist, you will be responsible for researching markets, developing creative angles, writing briefs, coordinating creative production, uploading/launching ads in Meta, and monitoring performance to identify what is working.



You should be comfortable working across multiple DTC eCommerce accounts and moving quickly without sacrificing strategy or quality.



You will work closely with media buyers, designers, video editors, UGC creators, and leadership to ensure each account has a strong pipeline of new creative.



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy



Develop creative strategies for DTC eCommerce brands running Meta ads.



Research customer avatars, pain points, desires, objections, competitor positioning, reviews, Reddit threads, TikTok trends, Meta Ad Library, Amazon reviews, landing pages, and customer language.



Identify new hooks, angles, offers, formats, and messaging opportunities.



Create clear creative testing plans based on performance data and market research.



Understand direct response principles, buyer psychology, and how to structure ads that convert.



Creative Briefs



Write detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators.



Include hooks, concepts, scripts, visual direction, claims/compliance notes, CTA, product positioning, and references.



Make sure briefs are specific enough that the creative team can execute without confusion.



Provide examples of winning ads, swipe files, and references when needed.



Meta Ads Execution



Upload, launch, and organize ads inside Meta Ads Manager.



Understand Meta campaign structure, ad sets, ad naming conventions, creative testing, and basic performance monitoring.



Know how to read creative performance inside Meta and identify winners, losers, and patterns.



Work with media buyers to understand what creative needs to be tested next.



Monitor active ads and help determine when creative needs to be paused, iterated, or scaled.



Creative Performance Analysis



Review ad performance by hook, angle, format, offer, product, audience, and creative type.



Identify why certain ads are working or not working.



Use performance data to inform future creative briefs.



Track winning patterns across accounts.



Help build a repeatable creative testing system.



Client-Facing Communication



Communicate clearly and professionally with clients when needed.



Present creative strategies, explain why certain angles are being tested, and provide updates on creative direction.



Strong written and spoken English is required.



You must be able to explain your thinking clearly on calls, in Slack, and in Loom videos.



Requirements



You must have experience with DTC eCommerce creative strategy.



You must understand Meta ads deeply, especially for purchase/conversion campaigns.



You must be able to upload, launch, and monitor ads inside Meta Ads Manager.



You must know how to create creative briefs that designers, editors, and UGC creators can actually execute.



You must understand customer research, competitor research, and offer positioning.



You must have excellent written and spoken English.



You must be comfortable recording Loom videos explaining your strategy.



You must be organized, fast, and able to manage multiple accounts.



You must be comfortable working with restricted or compliance-sensitive categories.



You must be available during some U.S. working hours. Between 6-9 am and 3-5 PM depending on your starting shift.



We are not hiring candidates located in North America, or citizens of North America for this role.



Nice to Have



Experience with CBD, supplements, peptides, telemedicine, health/wellness, or other restricted categories.



Experience sourcing or managing UGC creators.



Experience writing UGC scripts.



Experience with tools like Triple Whale, Motion, Foreplay, Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Shopify, or GoHighLevel.



Experience working inside an agency.



Compensation



Base pay: $1,500–$3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and skill level.



Bonus: $100/month per account that maintains KPI on a monthly basis.



Expected account load: 10–20 accounts per month.



If you are able to handle more accounts while maintaining quality, that is a plus.



Hiring Process:



Step 1: Application



You will complete the application questions below and submit examples of your previous work.



Step 2: Level 1 Test



If your application looks strong, we will send you a short Level 1 creative strategy test.



Step 3: Interview



If your Level 1 test is strong, we will schedule an interview.



Step 4: Level 2 Test



Final candidates will complete a paid, more advanced creative strategy test before an offer is made.



Application Requirements



Please answer the questions below carefully. Generic answers will not be considered.



You must also include a Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your experience and walking us through how you think about creative strategy.



Application Questions



Experience

How many years of experience do you have with DTC eCommerce creative strategy?



What types of products or industries have you created ad strategies for?



Have you worked with Meta ads specifically? Explain your experience with campaign setup, ad launching, and performance monitoring.



Creative Strategy

Walk us through your process for going from product research to creative angles.



What makes a strong Meta ad creative for a DTC eCommerce brand?



Share 2–3 examples of creative briefs you have personally created. Include links or screenshots if possible.



Research Process

What sources do you use when researching customers, competitors, and ad angles?



How do you find customer pain points, objections, and buying triggers?



Give an example of a time your research led to a winning ad angle.



Performance Analysis

What metrics do you look at when judging whether an ad creative is working?



How do you d
 whether to kill, iterate, or scale a creative?



Give an example of an ad that failed and what you learned from it.



Communication

This is a client-facing role. How comfortable are you explaining creative strategy to clients?



You MUST include a Loom video under 5 minutes introducing yourself and explaining your creative strategy process.



Rate your spoken and written English from 1–10 and briefly explain.



Availability & Fit

What country and time zone are you located in?

Are you available to work some U.S. business hours?

What monthly compensation are you looking for in USD?



How to Apply



DO NOT MESSAGE ME ON ONLINEJOBS.PH

YOU MUST submit the following to 
 portfolio.



Examples of creative briefs you have created.



Examples of ads you helped strategize.



A Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your creative strategy process.



Answers to the application questions above.

We are looking for someone who can plan, create, edit, publish and manage marketing campaigns across digital platforms. This role is not just about strategy. You must be comfortable producing content yourself, especially short-form video, UGC-style content, social media ads, reels, TikToks, testimonials, educational videos and practical IT advice content.



UGC, video editing and content creation are vital to this role.



A background in technical writing and a strong understanding of IT are also vital. You do not need to be a senior technician, but you must be able to understand technical concepts, ask the right questions, and turn IT topics into clear, simple, accurate and engaging marketing content.



Once the suitable candidate is settled into the Afford IT role, this position is expected to grow and incorporate marketing responsibilities across other related brands. This may include additional technology, cyber security, managed services, business advisory or specialist service brands connected to the wider business group.



This is an ideal role for someone who wants ownership, variety and the opportunity to help build multiple brands over time.



Key Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:



* Developing and managing marketing campaigns for Afford IT

* Creating short-form video content for
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn

* Producing UGC-style content that feels authentic, practical and relatable

* Editing videos, reels, ads, testimonials and educational content

* Writing captions, hooks, scripts, headlines and ad copy

* Writing technical marketing content in plain English

* Turning IT concepts into simple, useful and accurate customer-facing content

* Planning and managing a content calendar

* Creating marketing assets for social media,
, website and paid advertising

* Managing paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta, Google and LinkedIn

* Testing different ad creatives, hooks, offers and audiences

* Monitoring campaign performance and improving results over time

* Creating local area marketing campaigns

* Supporting SEO content, blog posts and website updates

* Helping generate leads for residential and small business IT services

* Creating before-and-after style content, explainer videos and client story content

* Repurposing long-form content into short-form clips

* Coordinating photography, filming or user-generated content where required

* Tracking marketing activity, leads, cost per lead and campaign performance

* Working with the Afford IT team to identify useful customer pain points and content ideas

* Gradually supporting marketing activity for other related brands once established in the role



Content Creation Requirements



This role requires strong hands-on content creation ability.



You must be able to create content that is clear, engaging and suitable for everyday consumers and small business owners. You must be able to make IT topics understandable without making them inaccurate or oversimplified.



You should be comfortable with:



* UGC-style video content

* Short-form social media videos

* Editing reels, TikToks and ad creatives

* Writing strong hooks and scripts

* Recording simple videos or coordinating video content

* Creating content that feels human, not overly polished or corporate

* Turning customer questions into educational content

* Creating trust-building content for local audiences

* Making IT services feel simple, approachable and valuable

* Writing technical content in plain English

* Explaining IT services, cyber security risks, device issues and technology problems clearly



This is a vital part of the role. Applicants who only have general marketing experience but no real content creation, UGC, video editing, technical writing or IT understanding will not be the right fit.



About You



You are creative, commercially minded and comfortable getting things done.



You understand that good marketing is not just about pretty graphics. It is about attention, trust, clarity and conversion. You know how to create content that people actually watch, and you are willing to test, improve and keep producing.



You also understand that marketing an IT business requires accuracy. You can take a technical topic and make it simple without making it misleading. You are comfortable learning about technology, cyber security, support services, devices, cloud systems and common customer problems.



You will be a good fit if you are:



* Strong at creating and editing short-form video content

* Comfortable with UGC-style marketing

* Able to write clear, punchy copy

* Skilled in technical writing or plain-English technical communication

* Able to understand IT services and explain them simply

* Creative with hooks, angles and content ideas

* Organised enough to manage a content calendar

* Commercially aware and focused on lead generation

* Comfortable working with paid ads and organic content

* Able to explain technical topics in simple language

* Confident using social media platforms for business growth

* Practical, proactive and willing to execute

* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of outcomes

* Interested in growing into a broader multi-brand marketing role



Required Skills and Experience



The ideal candidate will have experience with:



* Social media marketing

* Short-form video creation

* UGC content creation

* Video editing

* Technical writing or technology-related content creation

* Experience Marketing for IT, tech, cyber security, trades, local services or professional services

* Paid advertising campaign management

* Meta Ads

* Google Ads

* Content planning

* Copywriting

* Lead generation campaigns

* Basic website or landing page updates

* Analytics and campaign reporting

* Marketing products or services that require technical explanation



Highly Regarded



Experience with any of the following will be highly regarded:



* Understanding of managed IT services, cyber security, Microsoft 365, devices, networking or cloud services

* TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts

* CapCut, Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or similar editing tools

* Meta Business Suite

* Google Business Profile optimisation

* Local SEO

*
 marketing

* Landing page creation

* Customer testimonial campaigns

* Community-based marketing

* Scriptwriting for short-form ads

* Direct response advertising

* Working with small business brands

* Managing or supporting multiple brands



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means:



* Afford IT has a consistent and recognisable marketing presence

* Short-form video content is being created and published regularly

* UGC-style content is actively used in organic and paid campaigns

* Paid ads are generating measurable leads

* Campaigns are being tested and improved over time

* The brand feels approachable, useful and trustworthy

* Content explains IT problems in a simple and relatable way

* Technical content is accurate, clear and easy for customers to understand

* Local customers and small businesses are regularly seeing Afford IT online

* Marketing activity is tied to real business outcomes, not just vanity metrics

* The successful candidate becomes capable of supporting other related brands after settling into the Afford IT role



What We Offer



* A hands-on marketing role with real ownership

* The opportunity to shape the Afford IT brand

* Flexibility for the right person

* Room to test creative ideas

* A practical, useful service offering with strong content potential

* The chance to build a marketing engine from the ground up

* Exposure to other related brands as the role grows

* Support from a business owner who wants marketing to be a serious growth channel



Why Join Afford IT?



Afford IT is building a technology brand that people can actually understand and trust.



Most IT marketing is boring, confusing or overly technical. We want to do the opposite. We want content that is useful, simple, direct and human — while still being accurate.



This role is ideal for someone who loves content creation, understands modern advertising, can write clearly about technical topics, and wants to help build a brand through consistent, practical and engaging marketing.



Over time, this role has the potential to expand beyond Afford IT into other brands within the business group, giving the right person the opportunity to work across multiple audiences, offers and campaigns.



How to Apply

description:

conversations and follow-ups with property owners to build a strong pipeline of commercial

under this campaign.

terminology.

objection workflows.

- Fully covered infrastructure—all CRM user seats and automated dialer access are paid for.

- Direct collaboration with a highly active leadership team that actively leads by example.

title: NDIS rostering coordinator
description:
## Job Title



NDIS Rostering Coordinator — Disability Support & Workforce Scheduling



## Role Type



Remote / Offshore

Full-time

Australian healthcare and disability support business



## About the Role



We are looking for a highly organised and proactive NDIS Rostering Coordinator to support the day-to-day scheduling of disability support workers and client services across our growing Australian NDIS and care services business.



This role is ideal for someone with experience in rostering, scheduling, workforce coordination, disability support administration, healthcare administration or virtual operations support.



You will help ensure clients receive the right support, at the right time, with the right staff member. The role requires strong attention to detail, clear communication, fast follow-up and the ability to manage changes in a busy service environment.



You will work closely with care managers, support workers and management to coordinate shifts, update rosters, track staff availability, manage changes and maintain accurate records.



## Key Responsibilities



### Rostering & Scheduling



Create, update and maintain staff rosters



Allocate support workers to client shifts based on availability, location, skills and client needs



Monitor upcoming shifts and identify gaps or coverage issues



Assist with last-minute roster changes, cancellations and staff replacements



Update shift details accurately in the rostering system



Ensure rosters are communicated clearly to support workers and relevant managers



### Staff & Client Coordination



Communicate with support workers regarding shift confirmations, changes and availability



Follow up with staff who have not confirmed shifts or submitted required information



Support care managers with client scheduling needs



Escalate urgent issues, missed shifts, complaints or service risks to management



Help ensure clients receive consistent and reliable support



Maintain professional communication with staff, clients and internal teams



### Compliance & Administration



Maintain accurate records of shifts, staff availability and service changes



Assist with tracking staff documents, training, qualifications and compliance requirements



Support incident, cancellation and shift note follow-ups where required



Assist with timesheet checks and roster accuracy before payroll or invoicing



Help maintain clean and organised client and staff records



### Systems & Reporting



Use rostering, CRM, spreadsheet or care management systems to manage information



Prepare simple reports on roster gaps, staff availability, unfilled shifts or service issues



Keep trackers updated and accurate



Identify process improvements to make rostering more efficient



Support management with general operations tasks as required



## What We Are Looking For



Strong written and verbal English communication



Experience in rostering, scheduling, workforce coordination, healthcare administration or virtual assistance



Highly organised and detail-focused



Able to work quickly and calmly when roster changes occur



Confident communicating with staff and managers



Able to follow instructions and escalate issues appropriately



Comfortable using spreadsheets,
, online systems and shared folders



Reliable, proactive and able to work independently



Strong follow-up skills and ability to manage competing priorities



Trustworthy with confidential client and staff information



## Preferred Experience



Previous experience in NDIS, disability support, aged care, healthcare or home care rostering



Experience using ShiftCare, Brevity, CareMaster, Deputy, Employment Hero, Visualcare, Lumary or similar systems



Experience working with Australian businesses or clients



Understanding of support worker scheduling, client preferences and continuity of care



Experience with timesheets, shift notes, cancellations and service delivery administration



Experience working remotely with distributed teams



## What Success Looks Like



In the first 30 days, you will understand our clients, support workers, systems, rostering process and communication standards.



In the first 60 days, you will be confidently updating rosters, confirming shifts, managing staff availability, identifying gaps and supporting care managers with scheduling needs.



In the first 90 days, you will be helping improve rostering accuracy, reduce missed shifts, strengthen communication and create smoother workforce coordination across the business.



## Why Join Us



You will be joining a growing Australian healthcare and disability support business with a strong focus on quality service delivery, responsiveness and operational improvement.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to grow in NDIS operations, rostering, workforce coordination or care administration.



You will work closely with business owners, care managers and operations teams, and play an important role in making sure clients receive reliable and consistent support.

Your rostering, scheduling or workforce coordination experience



Any NDIS, aged care, disability support or healthcare experience



Systems you have used, especially ShiftCare or similar rostering platforms



Your remote work experience



Your expected monthly salary



Your availability to start

title: FOIA Researcher — Police Bodycam Footage (Long-Term, YouTube Channel)
description:
Long-term role sourcing raw bodycam footage for a YouTube channel through official FOIA / public records requests.



What You'll Do

File FOIA requests with police/sheriff departments to obtain raw bodycam or dashcam footage for specific cases. Track requests in a shared Google Sheet (case, date, location, agency, status, proof of request). Flag cases with strong potential — see below.



What Makes a Good Case

Look for a mismatch between the suspect and the crime (elderly suspects, parents, teachers, coaches, or other "trusted" figures doing something serious), clear conflict or escalation, an unexpected twist, and a satisfying resolution. No officer-involved shootings or fatal incidents.



Requirements

Proven FOIA / public records experience — must provide proof of past requests and successful acquisitions before being hired. Strong written English. Familiarity with state-level (not just federal) public records laws. Comfortable with Google Sheets and Trello. Able to work across multiple states/counties, not just one or two.



Pay

$20–25 per confirmed footage delivery (raw file or agency download link + proof of request) — paid per footage, not per hour or per request submitted. Include a short case summary with each delivery (date, location, charges, why it's a strong fit).



To Apply

Reply with "BODYCAM" so we know you read this, and include proof of at least one past successful FOIA acquisition plus the states/counties you've had the most success with.

title: Part-time content strategist — short vertical video
description:
We are looking for a part-time content strategist to work alongside an established video marketing and monetization brand. This is not an entry-level role. We need someone who has done this before, can prove it, and has a clear system for how they work.



About the brand



Keenya Kelly is a video marketing and monetization strategist with a large established audience across TikTok, Instagram, and
. We teach entrepreneurs how to grow through short vertical video and turn their content into consistent income. 



We have an active offer ecosystem including a membership, a flagship course, and low-ticket funnels. We are a systems-driven team that operates with clear processes, deadlines, and communication standards.



What we are looking for



You have a proven framework or methodology for creating content that grows accounts AND drives revenue. Not just views. 



Not just followers. Actual conversions and sales. 



You can show us accounts you have worked on, what the numbers looked like before you got involved, and what happened after. You think in systems. You do not wing it. 



You have a repeatable process for researching a brand, building a content strategy, and delivering direction that a team can execute consistently. 



You understand the difference between content that builds an audience and content that converts that audience into buyers — and you know how to build both into a strategy at the same time.



What this role involves



?Deep dive into the Keenya Kelly brand — audience, offers, voice, content pillars, and competitors — and develop a content strategy tailored to where we are going, not just where we have been



?Deliver weekly content ideas for Instagram,
, and TikTok — including hooks, format direction, caption angles, and CTAs that connect to our active offers



?Deliver Trial Reels concept per day for Instagram



?Build and hand over a content system our team can run — including a competitor database, hook library, and content direction framework



?Join bi-weekly strategy calls to review performance and align on the next content cycle



?Adapt content direction during active launch periods — we run live challenges, webinars, and course launch campaigns that require content to shift with the offer



What this role does NOT involve



You will not be posting, scheduling, editing videos, designing graphics, managing DMs or comments, or handling any execution. Our team handles all of that. Your job is strategy and content direction only.



You are the right person if



?You have a documented system or framework for content strategy — not just experience, an actual repeatable process



?You can show us at least two accounts you have grown that also became more profitable — with before and after numbers



?You understand short vertical video deeply — TikTok, Instagram Reels, and
 — and you know how to build strategy differently for each platform



?You are highly organized and can deliver on deadlines without being chased



?You are comfortable working alongside a brand owner who is also a strategist — you do not need to own the entire process 

to do your best work



?You communicate proactively and do not go silent when things come up



This is not the right role if



?You need to control execution in order to stand behind your strategy



?You are still building your process and learning as you go



?You cannot provide proof of accounts you have grown and monetized



?You struggle with structure, deadlines, or communicating your own process clearly



How to apply



Your application must include:



1. A brief description of your content strategy framework or system — how you approach a new brand from day one



2. Two or more examples of accounts you have grown and helped monetize — include the platform, the follower growth, and the revenue or conversion results



3. Your availability and your rate for part-time consulting work



Applications that do not include proof of results will not be reviewed. 



We are looking for someone ready to work alongside an established brand, not build one from scratch.

title: 3D Artist / 3D Animator (Intern to Mid-Level)
description:
Remote | Contract to Full-Time

We are a woman-owned creative studio based in Los Angeles, California working with VTubers, streamers, content creators, and digital brands.

This role will start as contract work with the goal of transitioning into a long-term full-time position as the studio grows.



This is a fully remote position with opportunities to collaborate internationally with creators, agencies, game developers, and animation studios.

Projects may include:

• VTuber assets and animated scenes

• 3D character models and character customization assets

• Stylized props, environments, and set pieces

• Motion graphics and promotional videos

• Unity-ready assets and scenes

• 3D renders for social media and marketing campaigns

• Interactive experiences for creators and communities
