• Create and animate 3D human characters, props, and environments

• Produce clean game-ready and animation-ready assets

• Work closely with video editors, audio engineers, graphic designers, and 2D animators

• Assist with virtual production and creator content pipelines

• Prepare models, textures, materials, and animations for Unity workflows

• Create cinematic renders and promotional visuals

• Optimize assets for performance when needed

• Organize project files and maintain clean production workflows

• Collaborate with the Creative Director and team to contribute creative ideas



What We Are Looking For

• Experience with Blender, Autodesk Maya, or similar 3D software

• Understanding of modeling, UV mapping, rigging, texturing, and animation

• Knowledge of stylized and anime-inspired art styles

• Ability to work from concept art and references

• Familiarity with animation principles and character movement

• Understanding of production pipelines and asset organization

• Reliable communication and ability to work remotely

• Ability to meet deadlines and manage creative projects



Preferred Software Experience

• Blender

• Autodesk Maya

• Substance Painter

• Adobe Photoshop

• Adobe After Effects

• Adobe Premiere Pro

• Unity

• ZBrush (Bonus)

• Unreal Engine (Bonus)



Bonus Skills

• VTuber/3D Gaming industry experience

• Character rigging and facial blendshapes

• Motion capture cleanup and retargeting

• Unity VFX and shaders

• VRChat or Warudo avatar creation

• Environment design

• Video editing and motion graphics

• Experience creating anime-style characters

• Basic scripting knowledge for Unity



Portfolio Requirements



Applicants must provide examples demonstrating:

• 3D character modeling

• Animation production

• Texturing and materials

• Environment or prop creation

• Wireframes or topology examples

• Rendered portfolio pieces

• Proof that the applicant personally created the showcased work



Portfolios lacking clear evidence of modeling, texturing, or animation work may not be considered.



Growth Opportunity

We are looking for someone interested in growing with the studio long-term.



As the company expands, this role can evolve into:

• Associate, Jr, Senior 3D Artist



Compensation ranges from $0.40 to $5.00+ USD per hour, depending on experience, portfolio quality, technical skills, and overall fit for the role.



This position is expected to average approximately 20 hours per week (80 hours per month) during the initial contract period. Based on this schedule, compensation ranges from approximately $32 to $500 USD per month.



The role will begin with a three-month trial contract period. Additional hours and responsibilities may become available based on performance, project needs, and studio growth.



We are looking for tea
mbers interested in growing with the studio long-term. Outstanding contributors may be considered for compensation increases, expanded responsibilities, leadership opportunities, performance bonuses, training opportunities, and future full-time positions as the company continues to grow.



Outstanding contributors may receive bonuses, equipment upgrades, training opportunities, and leadership responsibilities.



Please submit your portfolio and describe a vtuber’s 3D design you like and how you would go about modeling it.



Do not use AI to apply you will be disqualified. Do not apply if you are not a 3D artist.

Join Our Successful USA Construction Company!



We are a well established Construction/Engineering Company seeking an Experienced Civil Engineer/Project Manager to join our dynamic team. This is a full-time position for candidates committed to a long-term career. Visit us at 
 to learn more!



Salary & Benefits at CYPRECO INDUSTRIES, INC:

Monthly Contract: $1000 USD plus, additional compensation based on experience, and review after 90 days with salary increase for good performance.



Candidate Requirements

Please do not apply if you do not meet the following criteria:



- Minimum 3 years of experience in Commercial/Government Building Construction within the USA.

- Fluent in English with excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proficient in time management and task prioritization.

- University degree, preferably in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Engineering or a related field.

- At least 1 year of experience working from home, with the ability to work 40 hours a week on USA/New York time (night shift).

- Must have a home office setup including:

Dual monitors (minimum 20 inches)

Noise-cancelling headset

High-speed internet with a secure connection with convergys

Must have Webcam for Google Meet, and install necessary Employee Monitoring software

Backup power station for Wi-Fi and computer.

- Ability to work collaboratively via Google Meet with a counterpart in the USA.

Must provide a recent (2023) NBI clearance copy upon hire or within the first two weeks of employment.





Job Role Key Responsibilities:



Estimating/Bidding Procedures:



- Request Drawings and Specifications from Engineers/Architects for new construction projects.

- Download and organize drawings and specifications.

- Ability to perform quantity surveys, drawing take offs.

- Prepare scope of works and send out RFP requests to sub-contractors and vendors to obtain pricing prior to bid date.

- Manage RFP requests in order to obtain necessary pricing from vendors prior to bid.

- Data entry for bids filling in necessary company information and requesting bid bonds, insurance etc.

- Ability to work in Bluebeam, Stackt (on screen take off)



Purchasing:



- Ability to quickly search drawing and specifications with detail to answer technical questions to vendors.

- Ability to discuss project details in a technical capacity.

- Ability to source new vendors, and build long term relationships with subcontractors, and vendors.

- Negotiation skills necessary

- Build vendor/subcontractor directory and manage vendors.



Project Management:

- Quantity surveying & Estimating experience

- Prepare material lists after doing drawing take off

- Preparing CPM baseline schedule & manage schedule updates as necessary.

- Preparing Submittals and RFI's

- Managing Logs for Submittals, RFI's, Change Orders/Pending Items

- Technical review of Drawings and specifications. Ability to search documents to find discrepancies and prepare report on findings.

- Change order preparation/estimating.

- Ability to review drawings and specifications and compare to submittals for compliance.

- Ability to draft scope of works after careful review of drawings and specs to assist with preparing sub contract agreements

work with project manager to assist field team with innovate solutions for means and methods.





Engineering

AutoCAD, Revit, and drafting experience

ability to prepare shop drawings and sketches





To Apply:

Please follow these instructions carefully:





 your application to 



Use the subject line: CIVIL ENGINEERING APPLICANT - [Your Name].

Include the following in your
:

- Resume

- Speed test results

- A brief overview of your past experience and its relevance to this position.

- How long you’ve been working from home and what you enjoy about it.

- Link to your online job profile.

- A summary of your relevant skills.



NOTE* - This is not a role where AI can be utilized to perform tasks. This role, and many engineering tasks rely on human review and direct experience. while we believe in the use of technology we prioritize accuracy, human discretion, and judgement as critical roles in civil engineering.



We look forward to reviewing your application!

--

Regards,

Evangelos S. Tsivicos

title: Graphic Design
description:
Keenya Kelly LLC is a fast-moving social media education and content strategy company based in Houston, Texas. Our founder, Keenya Kelly, is a TikTok and Instagram Growth Strategist who has built a \ business over the last decade — primarily through short-form video. We help entrepreneurs grow their audiences and generate real revenue through strategic content.



We move fast, we have high standards, and we care deeply about the quality of everything that represents our brand. If you love creating visuals that stop people mid-scroll, make them feel something, and ultimately move them to take action — this is your kind of team.





THE ROLE

We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and fast-executing Part-Time Graphic Designer who can produce high-quality, on-brand marketing visuals that do more than just look good — they convert.



This is not a role for someone who simply places text on a background and calls it a graphic. We need a designer who understands marketing psychology, knows what catches attention in a social media feed, and can translate our brand strategy into visuals that sell our programs and services.



This is a long-term remote position for someone who is fast, communicative, and takes ownership of their work.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Social Media Graphics

Design scroll-stopping graphics for TikTok, Instagram,
, and LinkedIn that are aligned with current campaigns and promotions

Create visuals that are built for marketing — not just aesthetically pleasing, but strategically designed to attract attention and drive action

Produce graphics for organic content, launch campaigns, webinar promotions, challenge graphics, and product announcements

Design Stories, Reels cover images, carousels, and feed posts that stay consistent with our brand



Launch & Promotional Materials

Create full suites of promotional graphics for course launches, membership campaigns, challenges, and webinars

Design
 header graphics, sales page visuals, and promotional banners

Produce countdown graphics, announcement posts, and urgency-based visuals for cart open/close sequences

Design affiliate-ready promotional assets when needed



Brand Consistency & Asset Management

Follow our Brand Style Guide with precision — colors, fonts, logo placement, spacing, and tone must be exact

Maintain an organized library of brand templates, completed assets, and source files

Resize and adapt existing assets across platforms and formats without losing visual quality

Flag any design inconsistencies or outdated brand elements proactively



Collaboration & Communication

Receive creative briefs and turn them around in a timely, efficient manner

Ask clarifying questions before starting — not after spending hours going in the wrong direction

Communicate proactively if a deadline is at risk — no surprises

Accept feedback professionally and implement revisions quickly



WHO YOU ARE

The right person for this role is someone who:



Creates custom, original graphics from scratch — not relying on AI-generated imagery or generic stock templates as a shortcut

Understands the difference between a pretty graphic and a marketing graphic — and consistently delivers the latter

Has a strong eye for layout, hierarchy, color, and visual storytelling that stops a scroll

Knows how to use ChatGPT or other AI tools for quick copyediting, brainstorming caption ideas, or rapid ideation — but does not use AI as a replacement for original creative design work

Can turn around quality graphics efficiently — speed and quality are both non-negotiable on a launch-driven team

Reads a creative brief thoroughly and asks smart questions before diving in

Keeps files organized, properly named, and easy to hand off

Takes brand guidelines seriously and follows them without needing constant correction

Has experience designing for online businesses, personal brands, courses, memberships, or digital products

Is deeply familiar with TikTok, Instagram,
, and LinkedIn as platforms — and knows what performs visually on each





WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR

To help you self-select, here is what this role is not:



This is not a role for someone who produces one graphic per several hours of work — we need efficient, capable output

This is not a fit for someone who leans on AI image generation tools as their primary creative process

This is not a fit for someone who needs extensive hand-holding to execute a standard design brief

This is not a role for someone who treats brand guidelines as suggestions



TOOLS & PLATFORMS

You should be proficient in the following:



Design (Required)

Canva — advanced proficiency required

Design (Preferred)

Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or InDesign

AI Tools

ChatGPT for ideation/copy support only — not design generation

File Sharing

Google Drive or Dropbox for asset delivery

Communication



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AT 90 DAYS



You are a trusted creative partner on this team. Our brand looks consistent, polished, and sharp across every platform and every campaign. You deliver graphics quickly, require minimal revisions, and proactively flag anything that could make our content stronger. Launches feel smooth because the visual assets are always ready on time.





POSITION DETAILS



Employment Type

Part-Time with availability during US Central Time business hours for communication

Reporting To

Adora (OBM / Operations Lead) and Keenya Kelly (CEO)

Start Date

Immediate



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered for this role, please submit the following:



A link to your portfolio — we want to see extensive examples of marketing graphics you have created for online businesses, personal brands, digital products, courses, or memberships

A brief written introduction: who you are, what kind of design work you do best, and why you are a strong fit for a fast-moving personal brand team

Your available hours per week and preferred working schedule



IMPORTANT — Portfolio Requirements



Your portfolio must include marketing graphics — not just decorative or personal design work. We want to see graphics designed to promote a business, sell a product, run a campaign, or drive an audience to take action.



If your portfolio does not include this type of work, this role is likely not the right fit at this time.





We review every application and look forward to seeing your work. Only applicants who submit a complete portfolio and introduction will be considered.

title: Social Media Strategist/Executive Assistant
description:

The social media side is the bigger priority. You will be working directly inside Keenya’s brand — studying her content, her competitors, her audience, and her offers — and generating strategic content ideas that grow her accounts and sell her programs. This requires someone who has done exactly this for someone else’s business before, not just their own.

Non-negotiable qualifications. Do not apply if you cannot demonstrate all of the following:



Proven experience managing social media strategy for a client or employer — not just your own brand

You must be able to show us the account you managed, the content you created for them, and the results you delivered

Growing your own account is a plus, not a substitute for this requirement

Demonstrated results — follower growth, engagement improvement, or revenue generated for a client/employer

We need real numbers. Screenshots, analytics reports, or before-and-after data

Content calendar examples from client or employer work — show us how you planned and organized content for someone else’s business

GoHighLevel (GHL) proficiency — you should be able to navigate workflows, automations, and pipelines without training

Strong EA or operations background with real examples of how you have supported a CEO or business owner

Project management, inbox management, calendar management, SOP creation, and systems work

Funnel awareness is a strong plus — understanding how
 sequences, landing pages, and automations connect

Excellent written English — you will be writing, communicating, and representing this brand in writing daily

Available to work US Central hours, part-time





TOOLS YOU SHOULD KNOW

Social Media & Content

TikTok, Instagram,

ManyChat

Metricool or similar scheduler

CapCut (a plus)

Canva

Operations & Automation

GoHighLevel (GHL)

Kit / ConvertKit

Kajabi or similar course platform

Google Workspace

Notion

Communication & PM

Slack

Asana or ClickUp

Zoom

Loom





WHAT WE OFFER

Starting Rate

$6–$8/hour based on experience



US Central hours

Performance Review

After 12 months with room to grow

Environment

High-trust, faith-forward, fast-moving team





HOW TO APPLY

We receive a high volume of applications and we review every one carefully. To be considered, your application must include all of the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.



A short introduction about yourself — who you are, where you are based, and why you are applying for this specific role

Examples of social media accounts you have managed for a client or employer — include the account handle and your specific role in managing it

Measurable results from that client or employer work — follower growth, engagement numbers, or revenue impact with screenshots or analytics to back it up

A content calendar example you created for a client or employer

Examples of your operations or EA background — show us the systems, funnels, or automations you have built or managed

A 1–2 minute video introduction — speak to us naturally, tell us about your experience, and show us your communication style and personality



We are looking for someone who reads this posting carefully, follows every instruction, and submits everything we asked for. That alone tells us a lot about how you work.

title: Video Colorist
description:
We are Peak 3 Visuals, a video production company based near Seattle, Washington. We’re looking for a reliable remote assistant who can help process RED R3D footage overnight daily while our team is offline.

This is not a full creative color grading role. It is more of a technical batch-processing role.



*Please
 us directly through our website: Peak 3 Visuals dot com



The job would involve:

Downloading RED R3D footage

Applying a clean Rec.709 color correction

Adjusting basic exposure and white balance only

Exporting the clips as ProRes 422 Rec.709 files

Organizing the exports correctly

Uploading the finished files back to us overnight

The pay is $0.20 per processed clip.

Because this is overnight work for us, we’re looking for someone in an opposite or near-opposite timezone from Pacific Time. You also need very fast internet, ideally at least 1Gbps download and 1Gbps upload, since the files can be large.

Commitment: About 1-3 hours per day, 5 days a week depending on work load



To see if this is a good fit, could you send me:

Your timezone and normal working hours

Your computer specs

A current internet speed test

What software you use for R3D processing/color correction

Your experience working with RED R3D footage

Confirmation that you’re comfortable with the $0.20 per clip rate

Whether you’d be open to doing a small paid test batch

description:
About Us

We are a high-performing, lean $10MM e-commerce business based in Georgia, USA. Operating with a tight-knit team of 10 (3 in the Philippines), we value high leverage, smart systems, and zero bureaucratic bloat.



Role Overview

As our E-commerce Merchandising Manager, you will completely own product merchandising, from product data accuracy to how it's merchandised on the site to drive conversion rate. We are looking for a strategic, eagle-eyed leader who deeply understands how USA customers shop online and knows exactly how to configure a product listing for optimal performance.



In this role, you will drive revenue growth by strategically rearranging collections, optimizing sort orders, and building clear page hierarchies. You will be expected to quickly recognize when a listing image needs a tweak, when product data is incorrect, or when richer product information can lift conversion rates. Additionally, you will proactively identify Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) opportunities across the entire website.



Key Responsibilities

Storefront & Hierarchy Merchandising: Constantly analyze and rearrange collections, navigation structures, and product sort orders to optimize digital shelf space and maximize revenue growth.



Listing Optimization & Conversion: Audit product detail pages to ensure they are built to convert. Recognize when a product image needs to be tweaked or when copy and technical specifications require more clarity to ease a customer's buying decision.



Data Integrity Auditing: Maintain absolute precision across our catalog. Routinely verify data to catch and correct product information errors, pricing discrepancies, or technical specification mistakes.



Proactive CRO Identification: Serve as the internal champion for the user experience. Move through the site through the eyes of the consumer to identify friction points and map out new CRO opportunities.



Creative & Technical Direction: Know how to translate your merchandising and CRO insights into clear & actionable guidance to our front-end developers and graphic designers so they can execute your merchandising vision.



Job Requirements

E-commerce Merchandising Expertise: Strong background managing digital storefronts, product catalogs, and site architecture (Shopify ecosystem experience highly preferred).



Deep Shopper Empathy: A proven understanding of online consumer behavior, search intent, and the visual/textual elements that drive a customer to hit "Add to Cart."



Extreme Attention to Detail: An innate ability to spot minor data inconsistencies, formatting glitches, poor image quality, or missing product details that others overlook.



CRO & UX Mindset: Strong competency in identifying website usability issues and conversion blockers, with the ability to articulate those problems into solutions for technical teams.



Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional communication skills. You must be able to write clear, unambiguous instructions and briefs for remote designers and developers.



High Autonomy: A self-starter mentality. You thrive in a fully remote environment, manage your time effectively, and proactively solve problems before they are flagged to leadership.

title: YouTube Video Editor – Comedy Cooking Show
description:
About the Project



We are launching Grub, an energetic comedy cooking channel that blends a high-stakes culinary format with raw, backyard Aussie humor. Think MasterChef meets The Office or Sidemen cooking challenges.



The channel is run with 5 years of experience managing successful YouTube channels. I deeply understand the editing workflow, respect the craft, and am looking for a dedicated editor to collaborate with long-term. Once we establish a creative shorthand and a style we both love, you will have complete creative freedom over the cuts.



The Role & First Project



Our debut episode is fully filmed, and a 28-minute rough cut is already mapped out.



The Goal: Take the rough cut and transform it into a tight, fast-paced, highly engaging 12–18 minute polished YouTube video.



The Style: Sharp comedic timing, deadpan cuts to reaction shots, sudden snap-zooms, and clever audio/music cutouts to punctuate the humor.



What we DO NOT want: Over-the-top, flashy, TikTok-style text graphics popping up every second. The comedy should stem from the timing, human expressions, and pacing.



Technical Details: The raw audio, sound design, and pacing are unpolished. If you are not fully confident with color grading, don't worry—I can provide you with pre-graded footage, allowing you to focus purely on the edit and sound.



What We Are Looking For

YouTube Fluent: A strong grasp of YouTube pacing, storytelling, and audience retention strategies.



Software Requirements: Experience working inside Adobe Premiere Pro is required so we can easily exchange project files, assets, or XMLs if needed.



Creative Autonomy: The ability to work independently, find the funny moments in the footage, and pitch/inject your own jokes and comedic timing into the timeline.



Time Zone Alignment: Ability to occasionally communicate during Australian daytime hours (AEST / GMT+10) for asset handoffs and brief feedback loops.



How to Apply

To apply, please submit your application with the following:



Portfolio: A link to your portfolio or reel, specifically highlighting your best work regarding comedic timing, sound design, or pacing.



Software Check: Confirm you are using Adobe Premiere Pro (or let us know if you utilize an XML-supported workflow).



Please
 
 with a link to your profile.

title: Bookkeeper / Accounts
description:
Long-term role with a family-run Queensland agribusiness



Engagement Part-time to start (4 hrs/day), scaling to full-time for the right person

Hours Some overlap with Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST) preferred

Reports to Business owner

Software Xero (new file setup + ongoing)

Start As soon as the right candidate is found



About us

We are a family-run agribusiness in rural Queensland, Australia, running several enterprises under one roof. Our main business is a paddock-to-plate meat operation selling Wagyu and premium beef direct to customers at markets and online. Alongside this we run cattle, produce hay, do contract farm work, and make a natural tallow-based skincare range.

Because we have several income streams, we need someone who can keep our books clean and accurate, and show us clearly how each part of the business is performing. We are looking for one reliable, long-term person to take ownership of our bookkeeping and tax work so we can focus on running the farm.

The role

You will take over all of our day-to-day bookkeeping and tax-related work. The first big job is setting up a brand-new Xero file and moving us across from our current system. After that, you keep everything reconciled, GST-coded correctly, and ready for our Business Activity Statements (BAS) and end-of-year tax.

Important: all BAS and tax documents are reviewed and signed off by the owner before lodgement. You prepare; we approve.

What you will do

• Set up a brand-new Xero file from scratch and manage the changeover from our current system — chart of accounts, opening balances, bank feeds and contacts.

• Structure the accounts so each income stream (meat, cattle, hay, contract work, skincare) can be reported separately for both income and expenses — using Xero tracking categories.

• Process and reconcile all bank transactions across multiple accounts.

• Handle Australian GST correctly. Most of our food/meat sales are GST-free, while many of our supplier purchases include GST that we can claim back. You apply the right GST code to every transaction.

• Prepare Business Activity Statements (BAS) and supporting tax documents for the owner to review and lodge.

• Produce regular reports — profit & loss by enterprise, GST position and cash position — so we can see how each part of the business is tracking.

• Maintain accurate records for end-of-year tax and liaise with our Australian accountant when needed.

• Flag any errors, odd transactions or discrepancies early. We value someone who flags problems rather than hiding them.

Must have

• Solid hands-on experience setting up and running Xero (Xero certification / ProAdvisor is a strong plus).

• Good understanding of GST and the difference between GST-free sales and GST-inclusive purchases — or a strong tax background and the ability to learn the Australian system quickly.

• A bookkeeping or accounting qualification, with real experience keeping books for businesses.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy — this matters more to us than speed.

• Reliable internet, your own computer, and good written English.

• Honesty and discretion handling confidential financial information.

Nice to have

• Experience with Australian clients, BAS preparation, or the Australian tax system.

• Experience with multi-enterprise, farming or primary-production accounts.

• Confidence using Xero tracking categories for departmental / enterprise reporting.

Why work with us

• Long-term, stable role with room to grow your hours and responsibility.

• Real ownership of the books — you run the system, not just data entry.

• A friendly, straightforward team that values accuracy and clear communication.

How to apply

To apply, please send the following. Applications that answer the questions below will be prioritised — it tells us you read the ad and helps us find the right person quickly.

1. Your CV / resume.

2. A short note on your Xero experience and whether you are Xero-certified.

3. Your experience (if any) with Australian tax / GST / BAS.

4. Your hourly rate (in USD) and the hours per day you are available.

Please also answer these three quick questions in your application:

• In Xero, how would you set up the file so that income and expenses can be reported separately for several different parts of one business? (One or two sentences is fine.)

• If a sale is GST-free but the supplier invoice for that product included GST, how do you treat each side in the books?

• Have you prepared a BAS before, or worked with Australian GST? If not, how comfortable are you learning a new tax system?

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short paid test task before we make an offer.

As part of the reservations team, you are the first point of contact with guests. Your job is to provide fast and thorough responses to potential guests, provide exemplary customer service to maintain positive reviews, and mitigate guest issues. You are the vital link between our internal Helios team, vendors and all guests, and you must be adept at problem solving issues before filtering them to the rest of the team. You must be resourceful and know how to follow a myriad of SOPs to solve the many issues you will encounter. Initially you will be learning our operating procedures and how to communicate with guests via our messaging platforms. After 1 month, you will begin helping with inbound and outbound calls with guests.

Eligible for sick pay after 3 months.

Monthly performance bonus applied to the basic rate only, allowing the hourly rate to increase up to $5/hr for the month, based on performance.



Schedule:

Approximately 40 hours per week. Can be more during Peak Season Feb-April and can be less during the Slow Season of August-Nov. Given that this is the hospitality business, the ability to work weekends and holidays is required. Hours are during Pacific Time Zone sometime between 8am-11pm but hours are subject to change. 1 hour non paid lunch break provided each shift. Given that this is the customer service, we require you to be on your computer during your shift with an average response time of 5-10 minutes.



Key Responsibilities



Guest Relations: The Virtual Assistant shall be responsible for assisting guests throughout the entire reservations process, including pre-booking, during reservation dates, and post check out. The Virtual Assistant shall be responsible for monitoring all communications channels, such as OTA messages,
s, texts, live chats and calls. The Virtual Assistant shall maintain an average response time of five (5) minutes with a maximum of ten (10) minutes. The Virtual Assistant shall further be responsible for assisting with Upsells; collecting pre-check in documents; providing superior customer service and positive communication to all guests and review outreach.



Reservation Management: The Virtual Assistant shall need to understand the different payment terms, cancellation policies, and booking procedures on all platforms. The Virtual Assistant shall be responsible for collecting and verifying reservation payments; performing data entry tasks; verifying reservation payments and assisting with failed payments.



Automations: The Virtual Assistant shall be responsible for generating and deleting door lock codes; monitoring thermostat and settings on Home/Away mode; monitoring pool automation and coordinating heating, lights and spa functions; monitoring WiFi equipment and mediating outages; and monitoring noise sensors and resolving noise violations.



Listing Management: The Virtual Assistant shall be responsible for managing different booking channels, such as Airbnb, VRBO,

* Managing Microsoft 365 environments, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID and Intune

* Supporting Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP and Hyper-V environments

* Configuring and maintaining firewalls, switches, wireless networks and VPNs

* Supporting UniFi, business-grade networking equipment and security hardware

* Implementing and monitoring backup, disaster recovery and business continuity systems

* Investigating and resolving escalated technical issues

* Assisting with cyber security uplift, endpoint protection, MFA, conditional access and device compliance

* Performing system health checks, maintenance and proactive remediation

* Documenting client environments, processes, credentials and technical changes

* Working directly with clients in a professional and reassuring manner

* Assisting with project delivery, migrations, upgrades and infrastructure improvements



About You



You are someone who can think beyond the ticket in front of you.



You understand that good IT support is not just about fixing what is broken. It is about reducing risk, preventing repeat issues, communicating clearly, and leaving systems better than you found them.



You will be a good fit if you are:



* Technically capable and genuinely interested in networking, systems and security

* Calm under pressure and able to troubleshoot methodically

* Comfortable taking ownership of issues through to resolution

* Professional with clients, including business owners and managers

* Strong with documentation and process

* Practical, reliable and willing to work as part of a small team

* Interested in building long-term capability, not just closing tickets



Required Skills and Experience



The ideal candidate will have experience with:



* Microsoft 365 administration

* Windows Server and Active Directory

* Networking fundamentals including VLANs, routing, DNS, DHCP, NAT and VPNs

* Firewall, switch and wireless configuration

* Endpoint support across Windows devices

* Backup and disaster recovery systems

* Remote monitoring and management tools

* Cyber security best practices, including MFA, endpoint protection and access control

* Troubleshooting business-critical systems in professional environments



Highly Regarded



Experience with any of the following will be highly regarded:



* Microsoft Intune and device management

* Microsoft Entra ID and Conditional Access

* Hyper-V virtualisation

* UniFi networking

* VoIP systems

* Medical, legal, accounting or professional services environments

* PSA/RMM platforms

* Security frameworks such as Essential Eight

* Server migration or Microsoft 365 migration projects



What We Offer



* A role with real technical variety

* Exposure to meaningful infrastructure and security projects

* The opportunity to work directly with business clients

* A small, capable team with senior technical leadership

* A security-first approach to MSP services

* A business that values quality work, ownership and professionalism

* Room to grow as Defy IT continues to expand



Why Join Defy IT?



Defy IT is building a different kind of MSP.



We are focused on serious businesses that need reliable, secure and well-managed technology. We do not want to be the cheapest provider in the market. We want to be the provider clients trust when their systems actually matter.



If you are tired of rushed ticket work, poor documentation, reactive chaos and environments held together with guesswork, this is an opportunity to help build something better.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume and a short cover letter outlining your experience with networks, systems administration, Microsoft 365 and client-facing IT support.



We are looking for someone who can bring technical capability, clear communication and pride in their work to a growing IT business.

title: Part-Time Virtual Assistant (Maintenance Coordinator)
description:
Position Type: Part-Time Virtual Assistant

Schedule: Approximately 20–25 hours per week

Location: Remote



About Us



We are a growing property management team seeking a highly organized and proactive Maintenance Coordinator to support our maintenance operations. This role is responsible for ensuring maintenance requests, repairs, and turnover projects move efficiently from assignment through completion by coordinating vendors, obtaining estimates, tracking progress, and maintaining consistent follow-up.



Important



This position requires frequent phone communication with vendors and contractors. Candidates must be comfortable making outbound calls throughout the day using the company's phone system and possess strong verbal communication, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.



Primary Responsibilities

Work Order Management

- Monitor assigned maintenance work orders after assignment through completion.

- Verify that vendors have scheduled repairs with residents in a timely manner.

- Follow up on unscheduled, delayed, or aging work orders.

- Ensure vendors provide updates, invoices, photos, and completion details as required.

- Maintain accurate work order notes and documentation within company systems.

- Review open work orders weekly and proactively identify items requiring follow-up or escalation.



Vendor Coordination

- Communicate with vendors regarding scheduling, estimates, repair status, and completion timelines.

- Make frequent outbound phone calls to vendors to obtain updates, coordinate scheduling, request estimates, and resolve delays.

- Utilize the company's phone system to communicate professionally with vendors and service providers.

- Follow up consistently to ensure repairs remain on track.

- Build and maintain positive relationships with company vendors.

-  Escalate unresolved maintenance concerns to management.



Estimates & Owner Approvals

- Obtain estimates and bids for maintenance projects.

- Prepare owner approval requests with supporting information.

- Track pending approvals and follow up as needed.

- Coordinate approved repairs with vendors and monitor progress through completion.



Turnover Coordination

- Coordinate turnover projects between resident move-out and move-in.

- Obtain and compare vendor bids for turnover work.

- Submit turnover estimates for owner approval.

- Schedule approved work with vendors.

- Follow up weekly on active turnover projects and provide status updates.

- Help ensure turnover projects are completed on schedule and ready for leasing.



Maintenance Reporting

- Monitor work order aging and completion timelines.

- Assist with maintenance reporting and project tracking.

- Identify bottlenecks and communicate concerns before delays impact residents or property owners.

- Support company goals for response times, completion rates, and resident satisfaction.



Qualifications

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Strong professional phone presence and confidence speaking with vendors and contractors.

- Comfortable making frequent outbound calls throughout the workday.

- Ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and persistently when following up on outstanding items.

- Excellent organizational and time management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

- Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

- Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.

- Reliable internet connection, computer, and quiet work environment suitable for professional phone calls.



Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience in property management, maintenance coordination, project coordination, or vendor management.

- Experience with AppFolio or similar property management software.

- Experience coordinating contractors, service providers, or repair projects.

title: Wholesale Accounts & Sales Coordinator
description:
ABOUT PUFF HERBALS:



Puff Herbals is a growing U.S.-based herbal wellness brand creating thoughtfully formulated herbal cigarettes and smoking blends. Our products are completely tobacco-free, cannabis-free, and additive-free. We sell directly to customers through our e-commerce store and through independent retailers across the United States. We are looking for a proactive, organized, and relationship-focused Wholesale Accounts & Sales Coordinator to help us support our existing retailers and expand our wholesale business.



ABOUT THE ROLE:



This role combines wholesale account support, retailer research, sales outreach, order processing, and pipeline management. You will communicate with current and prospective retailers, help manage wholesale orders and reorders, identify aligned stores, conduct thoughtful outreach, coordinate samples, and maintain organized records of wholesale activity. You will also help create and maintain a central retailer database so that current accounts, prospective accounts, conversations, orders, and follow-ups can be viewed at a glance. This is not a high-pressure cold-calling position. We are looking for someone who understands relationship-based sales, communicates warmly and professionally, and follows up consistently. You will work directly with the founder and receive training on Puff Herbals’ products, brand voice, wholesale policies, target retailers, and sales approach.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



- Wholesale Account Support

- Manage routine communication with current wholesale retailers

- Monitor the wholesale inbox and respond to retailer questions

- Help retailers place opening orders and reorders

- Process wholesale orders accurately through Shopify

- Conduct personalized retailer check-ins and reorder outreach

- Identify inactive accounts that may be ready to reorder

- Maintain positive and thoughtful relationships with retail partners

- Escalate major opportunities, negotiations, or unusual requests to the founder

- Retailer Research and Lead Generation

- Research independent retailers that align with the Puff Herbals brand and customer

- Identify prospects such as apothecaries, herbal shops, wellness boutiques, gift stores, lifestyle retailers, smoke shops, and other specialty stores

- Review prospective retailers’ websites, social media, existing product assortment, and overall customer fit

- Find accurate buyer or store-owner contact information

- Use Overjoy and other approved research tools to build targeted prospect lists

- Prioritize qualified, relevant retailers rather than focusing only on lead volume



WHOLESALE SALES OUTREACH:



- Conduct thoughtful outreach to prospective retailers through
 and other approved channels

- Personalize outreach when appropriate

- Manage follow-up sequences consistently and professionally

- Respond to interested retailers and provide approved wholesale information

- Coordinate sample requests and follow up after samples are received

- Keep prospective retailers moving through the sales pipeline

- Schedule qualified retailer calls with the founder when needed

- Conduct limited phone outreach when appropriate

- Retailer Database and Pipeline Management

- Create and maintain a central retailer and prospect database

- Organize current, former, prospective, and newly opened wholesale accounts

- Import and clean relevant retailer information from Shopify and existing records

- Track outreach, responses, follow-ups, samples, orders, account status, and next steps

- Ensure every active account and prospect has a clear status and next action

- Provide a simple weekly update covering outreach activity, responses, opportunities, opening orders, reorders, and anything requiring founder input



OVERJOY AND WHOLESALE SYSTEMS:



- Learn and use Overjoy to research retailers and manage outbound outreach

- Complete available platform training and independently learn unfamiliar features

- Work with the founder and Overjoy support team to improve the existing outreach setup

- Build small, targeted lead lists and campaigns before increasing outreach volume

- Monitor lead quality, replies, and sales results

- Help improve outreach messaging based on performance

- Document repeatable workflows through written SOPs or Loom videos

- Keep wholesale line sheets, price lists, templates, and retailer materials organized and current



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



- Excellent written and spoken English

- Experience in sales support, wholesale, lead generation, account management, business development, e-commerce, or customer service

- Strong research skills and good judgment when evaluating retailer fit

- Warm, polished, and professional written communication

- Excellent organization and consistent follow-through

- Comfortable conducting outbound outreach on behalf of a brand

- Comfortable learning new software independently

- Strong Google Sheets or spreadsheet skills

- High attention to detail when processing orders and communicating product or pricing information

- Able to work independently and identify next steps without constant direction

- Comfortable working directly with a founder in a growing small business

- Experience with Shopify, CRMs, sales outreach tools, Overjoy, CPG brands, wellness products, or independent retail is preferred but not required.

- Applicants must be comfortable working in herbal smoking products.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION:



- This role will begin at approximately 10–15 hours per week. The schedule is flexible, although the work should generally be completed throughout the Monday-to-Friday workweek so that retailer messages and follow-ups are handled consistently.

- Compensation is $10–$12 USD per hour, depending on relevant experience and skill level.

- After the initial training period, there may also be opportunities to earn performance bonuses connected to qualified new wholesale accounts and successful account reorders.

- This is intended to be a long-term role. There is potential for increased hours and responsibility as Puff Herbals’ wholesale business grows.



HOW TO APPLY:



Please include the following in your application:

1. A brief introduction.

2. A summary of your most relevant experience in wholesale, sales outreach, lead generation, account management, e-commerce, or customer service.



Please only apply if you are comfortable with the posted compensation, part-time hours, and working with herbal smoking products. Please begin your application with “octopus” so we know you read the full posting. 



Selected applicants will be contacted for the next stage of the hiring process. Finalists will be invited to complete a brief paid skills assessment.

title: Up to $2000/MO Creative Operations Coordinator
description:
Creative Operations Coordinator



Growing Pains Marketing



Compensation



$1,000–$2,000 USD per month, depending on experience, communication ability, AI fluency, DTC eCommerce agency background, and ability to keep creative production moving independently.



About Growing Pains Marketing



Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency focused on helping DTC eCommerce brands scale through paid social advertising, primarily on Meta.



We work with fast-moving brands in competitive and compliance-sensitive categories, including wellness, CBD-adjacent, research compounds, alternative products, and other restricted markets.



Our creative process moves quickly. We produce ads, test angles, review performance, revise assets, coordinate UGC creators, and launch new creative every week.



We are looking for a highly organized Creative Operations Coordinator who has already worked inside a DTC eCommerce marketing agency and understands how fast creative production moves.



This person must also use AI tools daily to work faster, organize better, summarize information, create checklists, clean up tasks, improve communication, and help keep the creative team moving.



Role Overview



We are hiring a Creative Operations Coordinator to help manage the day-to-day creative production workflow.



This is not a traditional project manager role. This is a hands-on coordination role for someone who can use Asana, Slack, Google Drive, Notion/Sheets, and AI to make sure creative tasks are clear, updated, assigned, followed up on, and completed on time.



You will coordinate between creative strategists, designers, video editors, UGC coordinators, creator sourcers, and media buyers.



Your job is to make sure creative does not get stuck.



You will help answer:



What is being worked on?

Who owns it?

When is it due?

What is blocked?

What needs review?

What needs revision?

What is ready to launch?

Which UGC creators are waiting on outreach, shipment, filming, footage, or revisions?



Your main responsibility is to keep the creative production machine organized and moving.



Must-Have Requirements



You must have:



Previous experience working in a DTC eCommerce marketing agency.

Experience coordinating creative production for paid social ads.

Daily experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Notion AI, or similar tools.

Strong understanding of Meta ad creative workflows.

Experience working with designers, video editors, UGC creators, creative strategists, and/or media buyers.

Strong written and spoken English.

Strong organization and follow-up ability.

Strong attention to detail.

Comfort working in a fast-paced remote agency environment.

Ability to submit a clear Loom video that is 5 minutes or less.



Please do not apply if you have only worked in general admin, local service businesses, corporate project management, or non-eCommerce roles. We need someone who understands DTC eCommerce creative production.



AI Requirement



AI usage is a daily part of this role.



You should already be using AI to:



Summarize Slack threads.

Turn messy notes into clean Asana tasks.

Create checklists.

Draft follow-up messages.

Organize revision notes.

Identify missing information in briefs.

Create daily status updates.

Summarize blockers.

Improve task descriptions.

Build simple trackers.

Prepare weekly creative production summaries.

Improve communication speed and clarity.



You do not need to be an AI developer, but you must be comfortable using AI every day to work faster, think clearer, and keep projects organized.



A candidate who does not use AI daily is not a fit for this role.



What You’ll Own



You will help manage the workflow from creative request to final delivery.



This includes:



Making sure every creative task has a clear brief.

Making sure required assets are attached.

Confirming task owners and due dates.

Keeping Asana updated.

Following up with designers, video editors, UGC coordinators, and creative strategists.

Tracking what is in progress, blocked, waiting for review, needing revision, approved, or ready to launch.

Making sure revisions are tracked and completed.

Escalating blockers before they become major delays.

Making sure creative is submitted for internal review before client review or launch.

Helping the team stay focused on the highest-priority creative work.

Using AI to improve task clarity, summarize updates, and prevent missing details.

Core Responsibilities

1. Creative Production Coordination



You will coordinate the day-to-day creative workflow across multiple DTC eCommerce clients and projects.



Responsibilities include:



Review new creative tasks and confirm they are complete.

Make sure each task includes the script, brief, assets, product details, offer, CTA, brand notes, examples, and deadline.

Confirm who owns each task.

Track daily progress across design, video, AI video, and UGC projects.

Make sure tasks move through the correct stages.

Follow up when a task is stuck.

Make sure deadlines are visible.

Keep the team updated on priorities.

Maintain a clean production calendar or task board.

Help prevent missed deadlines, lost feedback, or unclear ownership.

2. Asana / Task Management



You will help keep Asana clean and accurate.



Responsibilities include:



Create or update creative tasks.

Add owners, due dates, priorities, descriptions, links, and assets.

Use AI to turn messy briefs, Slack threads, or notes into clear Asana tasks.

Make sure task statuses reflect reality.

Move tasks through the correct workflow stages.

Add comments and updates when progress changes.

Track blockers and dependencies.

Tag the correct people when action is needed.

Make sure completed tasks are only closed after final approval or delivery.

Make sure no task sits untouched without explanation.



The goal is that anyone on the team should be able to look at Asana and immediately understand what is happening.



3. Creative Team Follow-Up



You will coordinate with the creative team to make sure everyone knows what they need to do.



You will work with:



Creative Strategists.

Designers.

Video Editors.

AI Video Editors.

UGC Coordinators.

UGC Creator Sourcers.

Media Buyers.

COO / Leadership.



Responsibilities include:



Clarify task requirements.

Confirm priorities.

Follow up on progress.

Ask for updates before deadlines are missed.

Make sure feedback gets to the correct person.

Help resolve confusion between tea
mbers.

Escalate issues to leadership when needed.

Keep communication clear, professional, and direct.

Use AI to clean up unclear communication, summarize feedback, and turn conversations into action items.

4. UGC Production Coordination



You will help manage the UGC creator workflow.



You do not need to personally source every creator from scratch, but you are responsible for making sure the UGC process is organized and moving.



Responsibilities include:



Confirm when a script requires a UGC creator.

Make sure creator requirements are clear.

Track creator selection status.

Confirm outreach has been sent.

Track whether creators accepted, declined, or need follow-up.

Make sure shipping information is collected.

Coordinate with the team for product shipment.

Track product shipment status.

Track creator filming deadlines after product delivery.

Follow up on raw footage submissions.

Make sure raw footage is reviewed.

Track revision requests.

Make sure approved footage is handed off to the video editor.

Update Asana or the UGC tracker throughout the process.

Escalate creator delays, missing footage, shipping issues, or revision problems.

5. Revision and Feedback Tracking



You will make sure revisions are tracked clearly and completed correctly.



Responsibilities include:



Collect revision notes from leadership, creative strategists, clients, or media buyers.

Use AI to organize messy revision notes into clear action items.

Make sure feedback is clear and actionable.

Assign revisions to the correct tea
mber.

Track revision deadlines.

Confirm revised assets are submitted.

Make sure old feedback does not get lost.

Make sure the final version matches the requested changes.

Prevent duplicate, conflicting, or outdated feedback from creating confusion.

6. Creative QA Support



You are not expected to be the final creative approver, but you should help catch basic issues before assets move forward.



You should look for:



Missing assets.

Wrong product.

Wrong offer.

Wrong CTA.

Missing script.

Missing captions.

Incorrect dimensions.

Obvious spelling or grammar errors.

Text that is cut off.

Poor file naming.

Missing links.

Tasks submitted without all required deliverables.

Creative that has not followed the brief.



Over time, this role may grow into more formal creative QA support.



7. Daily and Weekly Updates



You will provide clear production updates to leadership.



This may include:



Daily creative status updates.

Weekly creative production summaries.

List of blocked tasks.

List of overdue tasks.

List of creative waiting for review.

List of UGC creators waiting on shipment, filming, or revisions.

Client-by-client creative output.

Tea
mber workload visibility.

Upcoming deadlines.



You should use AI to help summarize information clearly, but you are responsible for making sure the updates are accurate.



What This Role Is Not



This role is not primarily responsible for:



Writing ad scripts.

Creating creative strategy.

Designing static ads.

Editing videos.

Launching Meta campaigns.

Making final media buying decisions.

Being the sole UGC creator sourcer.

Owning final compliance approval.

Replacing the creative strategist.



You may help with some of these areas if needed, but your main responsibility is coordination, organization, follow-up, accountability, and AI-assisted workflow management.



Required Skills

DTC eCommerce agency experience.

Creative production coordination experience.

Strong understanding of paid social creative workflows.

Daily AI usage.

Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent organization.

Strong attention to detail.

Ability to follow up without being passive.

Ability to communicate clearly with designers, editors, strategists, and managers.

Ability to keep task boards clean and updated.

Ability to manage multiple projects at once.

Ability to identify blockers early.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced remote team.

Comfortable using project management tools.

Reliable internet and consistent availability.

Preferred Experience

Experience with Meta ad creative production.

Experience working with restricted or compliance-sensitive brands.

Experience coordinating UGC creators.

Experience using Asana, Slack, Google Drive, Notion, Google Sheets, or similar tools.

Experience working with creative strategists, media buyers, designers, and video editors.

Experience creating SOPs, trackers, checklists, or workflow documentation.

Experience using AI to improve team operations.

Tools Used



You should be comfortable using or learning:



Asana — task management.

Slack — team communication.

Google Drive — file and asset organization.

Notion — creator database or internal tracking.

Google Sheets — production trackers.

ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, or similar AI tools — daily workflow support.

Canva — optional, for basic creative review or asset checking.


, Loom, or similar tools — if needed for feedback and review.

Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is:



Experienced in a DTC eCommerce agency.

Highly organized.

Proactive.

AI-fluent.

Detail-oriented.

Clear in written communication.

Strong in spoken English.

Comfortable following up with people.

Comfortable holding people accountable professionally.

Able to manage multiple moving parts.

Not afraid to ask clarifying questions.

Good at spotting missing information.

Good at keeping systems clean.

Calm under pressure.

Reliable with deadlines.

Comfortable working with creatives.

Able to work independently after being trained.

Success Looks Like



You are successful in this role if:



Creative tasks are clearly organized.

Designers and video editors know exactly what they need to work on.

UGC projects are tracked from script to raw footage to final edit.

Deadlines are visible and followed.

Blockers are surfaced early.

Asana accurately reflects what is happening.

Leadership does not need to constantly chase the team.

Revision notes are not lost.

Creative output becomes more predictable.

The team feels more organized and less reactive.

Fewer tasks fall through the cracks.

AI is used daily to improve speed, clarity, and organization.

Key Performance Indicators



We will evaluate performance based on:



On-time creative delivery.

Number of overdue creative tasks.

Accuracy of Asana/task updates.

Speed of follow-up.

Number of blocked tasks surfaced early.

Revision tracking accuracy.

UGC production timeline tracking.

Team communication quality.

Reduction in missed details.

Quality of AI-assisted task organization and updates.

Leadership confidence in the production workflow.

Work Schedule



This is a remote role.



You must be available during agreed working hours and able to communicate consistently with the team.



Because our team moves quickly, you should be able to provide timely updates, respond to important messages, and keep projects moving without needing constant reminders.



Compensation



Compensation is $1,000–$2,000 USD per month, depending on experience and ability.



Higher compensation will be considered for candidates who have strong DTC eCommerce agency coordination experience, excellent English communication, strong AI fluency, and the ability to manage the workflow with minimal oversight.



How to Apply



To apply, please submit the following:



Your resume or work history.

A short description of your DTC eCommerce agency experience.

A short description of how you use AI every day in your work.

Tools you have used, such as Asana, Slack, Notion, Google Drive, Google Sheets, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity.

title: Remote Survey Programmer — Voxco / JavaScript Specialist (Market Research)
description:
Remote Survey Programmer — Voxco / JavaScript Specialist (Market Research)

Employer: TKW Research Group (Australia / New Zealand)

Location: Remote — Philippines

Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time equivalent (approx. 40 hrs/week)



The Package — What You’ll Receive



TKW Research Group is a long-standing Australian/New Zealand market research firm, and we’re looking for a Survey Programmer to join us on a long-term contract basis. This is a real partnership, not a transactional gig — and a chance to contribute to something genuinely new in market research. The package reflects that:



• Front-row seat on a voicebot R&D project — you’ll contribute directly to a survey voicebot we’re developing with a tier-1 AI platform partner. Real conversational-AI exposure on your CV.



• Base retainer: ?90,000 – ?140,000 PHP per month, commensurate with experience and voicebot project involvement, paid in arrears.



• 13th-month service bonus equivalent to one month’s base fee, paid every December.

• HMO allowance of up to ?50,000 per year, fully reimbursing premium private health cover for you and one dependent.

• Internet & equipment stipend of ?3,000 per month to support your home office setup.

• 10 days of paid leave per annum after 12 months of service, plus observed Australian public holidays without reduction to your base fee.



• Full training paid by TKW Research Group — structured onboarding plus ongoing platform training (Voxco and related tools) so you can perform at the highest level.



• Direct relationship with senior project managers in Australia/New Zealand — no middle layers, no agency markup.



About the Role



We’re looking for a Survey Programmer who can take complex questionnaires and turn them into clean, well-tested, production-ready survey scripts. You’ll own the scripting pipeline end-to-end: build, test, launch, deliver data.



Direct experience with Voxco is ideal, but we’re equally open to strong programmers from Forsta/Confirmit, Decipher, or Qualtrics who can pick up Voxco quickly — and we’ll fund the training to get you there. What matters more is that you can write real JavaScript (not just drag-and-drop survey builder logic) and that you sweat the details on QA.



The Voicebot Project — What Makes This Different



Alongside your core scripting work, you’ll contribute to something most survey programmers never get to touch: TKW Research Group is partnering with a tier-1 multinational AI platform provider to develop a survey voicebot — conversational AI that conducts genuine, natural-sounding interviews at scale.



Your role on the project: building the underlying survey logic, question structures, routing, and validation rules that the voicebot will run. You’re not expected to be an ML engineer — you’re the survey expert who makes sure the conversational layer asks the right questions in the right order and captures clean data on the other side.



This is genuine R&D work with commercial backing. You’ll be one of a handful of survey programmers globally with hands-on conversational-AI experience on your CV.



What You’ll Do

• Translate questionnaires (Word, PDF, client-supplied) into interactive online and CATI scripts.

• Build complex logic: skip patterns, routing, piping, randomisation, quota management, custom validations.

• Write JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3 to extend platform functionality where the out-of-the-box tools fall short.

• Test thoroughly — logic, edge cases, mobile rendering, accessibility — before anything goes live.

• Export and format data (SPSS, CSV, Excel) for the analysis team.



What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years programming surveys in a market research agency, fieldwork house, or specialised BPO.

• Strong JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 — you should be comfortable debugging in browser dev tools.

• Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise platform: Voxco, Forsta/Confirmit, Decipher, or Qualtrics.

• Bonus points for SPSS syntax, Python, SQL, or experience with conjoint/MaxDiff modules.

• Genuine interest in conversational AI — you don’t need ML experience, but you should be curious about how survey methodology and voice AI intersect.

• Reliable home office: high-spec PC, dual monitors preferred, stable internet plus a backup option.

• Strong written English — you’ll be communicating with project managers in Australia and New Zealand.



How to Apply



Send your CV plus a short note covering:

1. The platforms you’ve worked on.

2. The most complex script you’ve built.

3. Your earliest available start date.

4. A sentence or two on why the voicebot project interests you.

title: Virtual Medical Scheduler
description:
VISTA DERMATOLOGY

Virtual Medical Scheduler

Remote · Full-Time





ABOUT VISTA DERMATOLOGY

Vista Dermatology is an independent, physician-owned private practice built on a simple but powerful belief: every patient deserves to be treated like family. Unlike large corporate dermatology groups, every person on our schedule is fully ours, and we take that responsibility seriously.



Our patient experience begins the 
nt someone picks up the phone or submits an online request. We’ve built a reputation for excellence in clinical care, and we protect that reputation just as fiercely in every scheduling interaction. Our staff isn’t just answering a phone line, they’re nurturing relationships and setting the tone for everything that follows.



We’re a small but fast-growing practice. In our first year, we went from a team of eight to fourteen, and we’re continuing to grow. We compensate our team competitively, invest in their development, and have a strong track record of long-term retention. Our tea
mbers stay—and we’re proud of that.



ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re hiring our first Virtual Medical Scheduler: a remote, full-time hire who will serve as the first voice our patients hear. This is a high-volume, detail-critical scheduling role supporting a dermatology practice that handles 400–500 incoming calls per week across our appointment lines.



This isn’t a vague support role. It’s a focused, essential function: answer calls, schedule patients accurately, enter the right insurance information into our practice management system, and represent Vista Dermatology with warmth and professionalism on every single interaction.



If we hire well, we intend to hire a second virtual scheduler shortly after, and we’re committed to making this a stable, long-term position with a clear compensation path and real professional investment over time.



SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY

This role requires consistent, predictable availability. Our phones open at a set time each morning, and our patients expect someone to be there.



- Hours: 7:45 AM – 4:15 PM, Monday through Friday (40 hours/week)

- Time Zone: Central Time (US)

- Lunch break: 12:15 PM – 12:45 PM (30 minutes)

- The 7:45 AM start allows time to review
s, check messages, and be ready before calls begin

- Phones close to active callers at 4:00 PM; the final 15 minutes are used to close out to-do lists and contact the manager with any remaining questions

- Attendance is non-negotiable — this is the first point of contact for our patients

- Tardiness policy: notify the office manager by phone at least 10 minutes before your start time if late; no more than 2 late arrivals per rolling 30-day period

- Punctuality is treated as a core professional standard, not a preference



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your day will be primarily driven by live call volume, with additional responsibilities added incrementally as you become proficient. Tasks are prioritized in the following order:



1. Live Scheduling Calls (Primary Responsibility)

- Answer 200–300+ inbound scheduling calls per week with professionalism and warmth

- Collect accurate patient demographic, insurance, and appointment information

- Enter all information correctly into our EMA (Modernizing Medicine/ModMed) practice management system; this is the first entry point of the patient chart

- Verify insurance eligibility using our credentialing grid (updated regularly; the most current version must always be used)

- Send patients the correct intake paperwork and obtain required credit card authorizations

- Follow each scheduling step consistently and in order — every time, without skipping steps

- Transfer calls appropriately when a patient has a clinical question outside the scope of scheduling



2. Online Scheduling Support (Added After Proficiency)

- Process online scheduling requests and messages submitted through the patient portal

- Manage online scheduling queue after demonstrating consistency on live calls



3. Voi
 & Reschedule Callbacks (Added After Proficiency)

- Return voi
 messages within a strict callback window

- Handle reschedule requests and cancellations professionally



4. Fax & Referral Processing (Added After Proficiency)

- Process incoming fax referrals and scheduling records from outside providers



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

This role is not high-level complexity, but it demands a very specific kind of person. The work that looks deceptively simple on paper consistently separates strong performers from those who don’t make it past week two.



You're a fit if you:

- Have excellent spoken and written English — clarity and professionalism are non-negotiable

- Type 50–70 words per minute with high accuracy

- Are calm, patient, and consistent even during high call volume

- Are naturally detail-oriented and take following a process seriously

- Can sit at a computer for extended periods and navigate modern software with ease

- Value stability and doing one thing excellently

- Have a computer-comfortable background: past work in data entry, sales systems, student platforms, or similar computer-heavy environments

- Understand that accuracy matters more than speed in the early stages

- Are comfortable working during U.S. Central Time business hours



This Role Is NOT a Fit If You:

- Thrive on constant variety and creative problem-solving

- Prefer physical, hands-on work environments

- Have difficulty sitting attentively at a computer for a full workday

- Are looking for a steppingstone to a different kind of role quickly

- Are not comfortable with detailed, step-by-step processes that must be followed precisely

- Have limited experience with modern computer systems or software



TOOLS & SYSTEMS YOU'LL WORK WITH

You do not need prior experience with these specific platforms, but you must be comfortable and confident with modern computer systems. Our staff has consistently found that tech-savvy individuals pick up our systems quickly.



- ModMed (EMA / Modernizing Medicine): our all-in-one electronic health record, scheduling, and practice management system

- Klara: HIPAA-compliant secure messaging with patients

- RingCentral: our phone system (call volume is monitored and reviewed weekly)

- Gusto: payroll and time tracking

- Insurance Credentialing Grid: must be reviewed and used on every scheduling call; updated regularly

- HIPAA compliance is expected in all digital communications: all patient information is protected health information (PHI)



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Because this is a remote, HIPAA-regulated role, your home setup must meet the following minimum standards before your start date:



Internet & Connectivity

- Minimum 10 Mbps download / 5 Mbps upload speeds (25 Mbps preferred for video)

- A direct Ethernet (LAN) cable connection is strongly preferred over Wi-Fi for maximum stability

- A backup internet source is required



Hardware & Software

- PC with at least Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 processor and 8 GB RAM (16 GB preferred)

- Operating system: Windows 10/11 or macOS 12+

- HD webcam (minimum 720p) for video check-ins

mber; ModMed video tutorials; meeting with office manager at end of week

We believe the best way to reward great work is through a strong, reliable hourly rate with clear raises you can count on as you grow with us. title: Sales & Personal Assistant (Wholesale Leads)
description:
Lead Research · Outreach · Follow-Up · PA Support  ·  Remote (Philippines)

Help a family-run Queensland farm get its premium beef into restaurants, clubs and venues



Engagement Part-time to start (4 hrs/day), scaling to full-time for the right person

Hours Some overlap with Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST) preferred

Reports to Business owner

Core job Find venues that could stock our beef, reach out, follow up, and book us meetings

Target area South-East Queensland + Northern NSW (where we deliver)

Start As soon as the right candidate is found



About us

We are a family-run farm in rural Queensland, Australia. We raise and sell premium Wagyu and grass-fed beef direct to customers — at farmers’ markets, from our market van, and online — and we deliver across South-East Queensland and Northern New South Wales. Everything we sell is real, whole food with no preservatives or artificial ingredients.

Now we want to grow our wholesale side — getting our beef onto the menus and shelves of restaurants, clubs, pubs and function venues. We need someone organised and personable to find these venues, make first contact, follow up, and line up meetings for the owner. There’s also general personal-assistant work to help keep the business running smoothly.

The role

Your main job is building our wholesale sales pipeline. You’ll research venues in our delivery area, find the right person to talk to, send a friendly first approach, follow up politely until you get an answer, and book interested venues in for a chat with the owner. You keep it all organised in a simple tracker so nothing falls through the cracks. Alongside this, you’ll help with general PA tasks.

Note: you research, reach out and follow up to book the meeting — the owner does the actual sales meeting and pricing. You are the engine that fills the calendar.

What you will do

• Research venues that could buy our beef — restaurants and cafés, pubs, clubs and RSLs, and hotels, caterers and function venues — across South-East Queensland (Brisbane, Sunshine Coast, Toowoomba) and Northern NSW.

• Build a clean, organised contact list / spreadsheet for each venue: name, location, the right contact person (owner, head chef or buyer), phone,
 and any notes.

• Send a friendly, professional first approach by
 (and message where suitable) introducing our farm and range.

• Follow up politely and persistently — most replies come after a second or third nudge — until you get a yes, no, or a booked meeting.

• Book interested venues into the owner’s calendar for a call or visit, with all the background notes ready.

• Keep the whole pipeline organised in a simple CRM or spreadsheet so we always know who’s been contacted and what’s next.

• Help with general PA tasks — inbox and calendar help, simple documents, data entry, and other admin to keep things running.

Must have

• Experience with B2B lead research / list building — finding businesses and the right contact details online.

• Experience with cold or warm outreach 
/message) and polite, persistent follow-up.

• Excellent written English — your
s represent our brand and must read warmly and professionally.

• Strong organisation: comfortable building and maintaining spreadsheets or a CRM.

• Self-motivated and reliable — you chase leads without being chased yourself.

• Reliable internet and your own computer.

Nice to have

• Experience with food, hospitality, or wholesale/distribution clients.

• Experience selling to or researching Australian businesses.

• Familiarity with a CRM (e.g. HubSpot, Zoho) or outreach tools.

• Comfortable making occasional calls if needed.

Why work with us

• A clear, rewarding mission — every venue you sign is real growth you helped create.

• A genuine, likeable brand with a great story and products that are easy to introduce.

• Long-term, stable role with room to grow hours, pay and responsibility as results come in.

How to apply

Applications that answer the questions below will be prioritised — it shows us you read the ad and helps us find the right person quickly. Please send:

1. Your CV / resume.

2. A short note on your lead-research and outreach experience (and any tools you’ve used).

3. Your hourly rate (in USD) and the hours per day you are available.

And please answer these in your application:

• Pick ONE suburb in Brisbane or the Sunshine Coast. List THREE real restaurants or venues there that you think would suit premium local beef, with a link to each. (This shows us how you research.)

• Write the first two or three sentences of a friendly outreach
 introducing our farm to a head chef. Keep it warm and professional.

. What do you do next, and when?

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short paid test task before we make an offer.

You will be responsible for helping build the Defy IT sales database and CRM structure, then using that system to research prospects, manage outreach, track opportunities and book qualified appointments for the Defy IT leadership team.



This role suits someone who is organised, commercially minded and comfortable creating structure where there is currently very little. You will need to be able to take direction, but also think for yourself, identify gaps and improve the process as we grow.

* Helping set up and organise the Defy IT CRM

* Creating lead stages, pipeline views, tags, categories and follow-up workflows

* Building targeted prospect lists across selected industries and regions

* Researching businesses that match Defy IT’s ideal client profile

* Finding and recording key decision-makers, including business owners, directors, practice managers and office managers

* Enriching CRM records with useful information such as industry, location, size, website, phone number, LinkedIn profile and current IT indicators where available

* Cleaning and maintaining CRM data

title: Reddit VA - Build & Manage a Network of Reddit Account Holders
description:
We are an established Reddit marketing platform serving clients worldwide. We're scaling up and looking for a serious, Reddit-savvy person to own one specific thing: building and managing a network of people who have real, active Reddit accounts, and coordinating the work that flows through them.



This is not a generic VA role. You need to genuinely understand how Reddit works, karma, account age, subreddit rules, shadowbans, what gets removed and why. If you don't know what CQS or a shadowban is, this role isn't for you.





WHAT YOU'LL DO:



- Recruit and grow a network of reliable people who own real Reddit accounts (or have access to accounts in good standing)

- Onboard, vet, and manage these account holders as your team

- Assign and coordinate tasks across the network (comments, posts, upvotes) based on client orders we send you

- Quality-check work before it's delivered: right subreddit, natural-looking, not removed

- Keep your network active, reliable, and growing over time

- Track who did what, handle payouts to your network, and report results back to us





WHO YOU ARE:



- Deeply familiar with Reddit (you use it daily and understand the culture)

- You already have OR can quickly build a community/network of Reddit account holders

- Organized and reliable, you can manage people and tasks without being micromanaged

- Good written English for coordinating with us and your network

- Discreet and professional, you understand this is a marketing service business





BONUS POINTS:



- You already run or are part of a group of Reddit users / freelancers

- Experience with Reddit marketing, SMM, or social media growth

- Familiar with tools for managing multiple accounts





PAY:



We're open on structure, salary, per-task, commission, or a mix. Tell us what makes sense for you based on what you can deliver. Strong performers will grow with us as we scale.





TO APPLY:



Don't send a generic application. Tell us:

1. Your experience with Reddit (how long, what you've done)

2. Do you currently have a network of Reddit account holders? How many? If not, how would you build one?

3. Share your Reddit username

4. Your proposed pay structure



Applications that answer these get reviewed first. We're hiring someone serious for the long term.
